lang.aeronautics.ponder.burner_pressure.heade: Effect of Air Pressure on Hot Air Burners
lang.aeronautics.ponder.burner_pressure.text_: Hot Air Burners are affected by Air Pressure
Simulated Contraptions will settle when Lift and Weight are in balance
Changing Lift thus allows changing Altitude
The precise Air Pressure can be read from an Altitude Sensor
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_1: Envelope Blocks enclose a volume that generates Lift when filled with Hot Air
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_2: Hot Air sources fill Balloons from the top downwards
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_3: Hot Air must be contained by Airtight Blocks
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_4: Shafts can be encased with Envelope Blocks to make them airtight
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_5: Blocks inside the Balloon will reduce the available Volume
lang.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_6: Right-Click with Dye to paint them
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.header: Effect of Air Pressure on Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_1: Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings are affected by Air Pressure
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_3: Simulated Contraptions will settle when Thrust and Weight are in balance
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_4: Changing Thrust thus allows changing Altitude
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_5: The precise Air Pressure can be read from an Altitude Sensor
lang.aeronautics.ponder.gyroscopic_propeller_: Stabilizing using upside down Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings
When Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings are facing downwards...
Controlling Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings with Redstone
Sometimes the upwards Tilt can be undesired
Applying a Redstone signal will reset the Tilt to zero
Stabilizing helicopters using Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings
Normal Propeller Bearings may be unsuitable for helicopters
Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings should be used in this situation
The Gyroscopic Propeller Bearing attempts to keep the propeller upright
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.header: Generating Lift using the Hot Air Burner
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_1: Hot Air Burners generate Lift by filling Balloons with Hot Air
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_2: When Powered with Redstone, the Hot Air Burner will gradually fill the Balloon above itself
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_3: The input panel can be used to select the maximum Hot Air output
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_4: Adjusting the Redstone Input will scale the selected output proportionally
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_5: The Lift Force is limited by the size of the Balloon
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_6: Multiple Hot Air Burners can combine their output into a single Balloon
lang.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_7: For aesthetic purposes, the fire type can be changed with a Soul-Infused item
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_1: When enough Levitite is attached to a simulated contraption...
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_3: Simulated Contraptions cannot gain altitude using Levitite alone
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_5: At low movement speeds, Levitite significantly resists motion
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_6: This resistance drops at higher movement speeds
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_1: Levitite Blend can be crystallized into Levitite
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_3: Once catalyzed, the Levitite cannot be recollected
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_4: Nearby heat sources can also start the crystallization process
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_5: After the reaction is started, the crystal will spread throughout the entire fluid
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_6: When certain blocks are used to cast Levitite...
lang.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_7: ...they will be destroyed during the crystallization process
lang.aeronautics.ponder.miniprop_pressure.hea: Effect of Air Pressure on Propellers
lang.aeronautics.ponder.miniprop_pressure.tex: Propellers are affected by Air Pressure
The precise Air Pressure can be read from an Altitude Sensor
lang.aeronautics.ponder.mounted_potato_cannon: The Mounted Potato Cannon is a block version of the Potato Cannon
It accepts the same ammo as the Potato Cannon...
...and can be loaded by automated means
Use rotational force to charge up the Cannon
After the Cannon is fully charged, power it with redstone to fire
The Cannon can be continuously powered for automatic fire
lang.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_bearing_siz: Propeller Bearings attach to the block in front of them
Propellers with more sails are more efficient at producing Thrust
Any structure can count as a valid Propeller, as long as it has at least 2 valid sail-like blocks
lang.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_bearing_thr: Several types of propellers can produce Thrust
Reversing the rotation direction reverses the Thrust
The Thrust can also be reversed using a wrench
If the Propeller is moving through the air, it cannot push as hard, as the air is already moving
The Propeller's Thrust and Airflow can be inspected with Engineer's Goggles
lang.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_pressure.he: Effect of Air Pressure on Propeller Bearings
lang.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_pressure.te: Propeller Bearings are affected by Air Pressure
The precise Air Pressure can be read from an Altitude Sensor
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.header: Generating Lift using the Steam Vent
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_1: Steam Vents generate Lift by filling Balloons with Steam
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_2: When Powered with Redstone, the Steam Vent will gradually fill the Balloon above itself
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_3: Like Steam Engines, sufficient Heat, Water, and Boiler Space are required
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_4: The input panel can be used to select the maximum Steam output
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_5: Adjusting the Redstone Input will scale the selected output proportionally
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_6: The Lift Force is limited by the size of the Balloon
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_7: Multiple Steam Vents can combine their output into a single Balloon
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_8: Note an adequate power level is needed for multiple Steam Vents to run at full capacity
lang.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_9: For aesthetic purposes, the metal can be changed with an Iron Sheet
lang.aeronautics.ponder.tag.levitite_breakabl: Blocks that are broken when nearby Levitite Blend crystallizes into Levitite. Useful for making molds for casting

lang.offroad.ponder.borehead_bearing_efficien: The more blocks a Borehead Bearing attempts to break, the slower it will operate

lang.offroad.ponder.borehead_bearing_excavati: Unlike regular Drills, Rock Cutting Wheels break blocks in a range around themselves
lang.offroad.ponder.borehead_bearing_intro.he: Using Borehead Bearings and Rock Cutting Wheels
lang.offroad.ponder.borehead_bearing_intro.te: Borehead Bearings attach to the block in front of them
When a Storage Container and Rock Cutting Wheels are present, it can be used as a Drill
Rock Cutting Wheels will automatically attach to blocks and each other without need of Super Glue
The Borehead Bearing reverses the direction of Rotation...
...and spins at 0.25x the provided Rotational Speed
The mining speed depends on the Rotational Input...
...and drops are collected into the drill Storage automatically
When the drill Storage is full, it will be unable to continue breaking blocks
To remedy this, items can be extracted directly from the Borehead Bearing

lang.simulated.ponder.altitude_sensor_into.te: The Altitude Sensor outputs a redstone signal based on its elevation
By default, travelling upwards increases the signal strength
The minimum and maximum altitudes can be changed in the UI
It can also be set to decrease in strength as it travels upwards
When wearing Engineers' Goggles, information about air pressure and exact altitude can be seen
A Wrench can also be used to see more precise changes in elevation
lang.simulated.ponder.analog_transmission.hea: Controlling rotational speed using Analog Transmission
lang.simulated.ponder.analog_transmission.tex: Unpowered Analog Transmissions behave exactly like Encased Cogwheels
Analog redstone inputs slows down the cogwheel relative to the shaft
Higher signal strengths results in larger gear ratios
When the Transmission gets its input through the cogwheel, the shaft speeds up instead
At full signal input or breaking speeds, the shaft and cogwheel disconnect...
...and can then rotate independently of each other
Extracting from Harvesting actors using the Auger Shaft
Auger Shafts collect materials from Harvesting actors
All horizontally connected actors are included
When a connected actor breaks a block...
lang.simulated.ponder.auger_shaft_intro.text_: Powered Auger Shafts will transport items and extract them from actors
Using a Wrench, you can cycle between the Auger Shaft and Auger Cog
Using Industrial Iron Blocks, Auger Shafts can be encased
Item flow can be observed via the indicator on the Auger Cog...
...Or by inspecting the Auger while wearing Goggles
Items cannot be inserted or extracted from the Auger Cog...
lang.simulated.ponder.directional_gearshift.h: Controlling rotational direction using Directional Gearshift
lang.simulated.ponder.directional_gearshift.t: Unpowered Directional Gearshifts do not relay rotational power
When the straight side is powered, it will relay rotation
When the reverse side is powered, it will reverse rotation
When both sides are powered, it will stop relaying rotation
lang.simulated.ponder.directional_receiver.te: Directional Linked Receivers can detect the angle to other nearby Redstone Links
Redstone Links directly infront will be received at their full signal strength
A shallower angle results in a lower received signal strength
Directional Linked Receivers cannot receive signals from Redstone Links behind them
Directional Linked Receivers respect the same item frequencies that Redstone Links use
lang.simulated.ponder.docking_connector.text_: Docking Connectors can create rigid connections in pairs
Extended Connectors attempt to align with each other
Once sufficiently aligned, the Connectors will lock together
The Connection is rigid, but keeps the two sides independent
Once locked, Items and Fluids can be transferred in either direction
Insertion and Extraction must occur on both sides of the connection
Either Connector can be retracted to undock
Redstone Comparators can be used to read the Docking progress
lang.simulated.ponder.gimbal_sensor_intro.tex: The Gimbal Sensor outputs a redstone signal based on its orientation
By default, the signal is emitted downhill
The value boxes can configure the angle of maximum signal...
Each axis operates independently of one another
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_1: Honey Glue is a convenient alternative to Super Glue for Simulated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_2: Clicking two endpoints creates a new 'glued' area...
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_3: ...which can be expanded or retracted via Ctrl-Scrolling
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_4: Alternatively, hold ALT to place an endpoint midair
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_6: ...Honey Glue does not attach to animated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_7: Instead, it exclusively attaches to Simulated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_super_glue.h: Using Honey Glue with Super Glue
lang.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_super_glue.t: Honey Glue may be preferable in this scenario
When assembled, Honey Glue will attach to overlapping Super Glue
However, Super Glue will not attach to overlapping Honey Glue
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.header: Using Laser Pointers and Laser Sensors
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_1: Laser pointers emit a laser when powered
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_2: The laser can be obstructed by blocks
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_3: Laser Sensors can detect the laser when unobstructed
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_4: They will emit a signal dependent on the laser power
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_6: ...only lasers with matching colors will activate the sensor
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_7: Right clicking the front or back face with a wrench inverts redstone power
lang.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_8: The max casting distance can be adjusted on the back
lang.simulated.ponder.modulating_receiver.tex: Modulating Linked Receivers can detect the distance to other nearby Redstone Links
Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
This allows setting a minimum range...
Redstone Links within the minimum range will be received at their full signal strength
Redstone Links outside the maximum range will not be received at all
Redstone Links in-between the two ranges will be received with proportional signal strengths
Modulating Linked Receivers respect the same item frequencies that Redstone Links use
lang.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_1: The Navigation Table provides redstone feedback for Navigation Items
lang.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_2: When a Navigation Item is provided...
lang.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_3: ...it will emit a Redstone signal towards the destination
lang.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_4: The Redstone signal is weaker when not directly facing the destination
lang.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_5: Different Navigation Items provide unique targets
lang.simulated.ponder.nozzle.text_1: Nozzles attached to fans on Simulated Contraptions push away from nearby surfaces
lang.simulated.ponder.nozzle.text_2: Nearby walls will be pushed away from horizontally
lang.simulated.ponder.nozzle.text_3: Fluids also act as a surface
lang.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_1: Optical Sensors can detect blocks which obstruct its laser pointer
lang.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_2: When a block is detected, a Redstone signal is emitted
lang.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_3: The Optical Sensor's signal strength is relative to its detected block's distance
lang.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_4: The maximum distance can be configured using the value panel
lang.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_6: ...only matching blocks will emit a signal
lang.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_block: Some blocks may have different weights...
lang.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_intro: The Physics Assembler assembles blocks into Simulated Contraptions
Use Super Glue or Honey Glue to select a group of blocks...
...then hold right-click and pull the lever to assemble
Note that blocks along diagonal edges are included
Once assembled, the original Physics Assembler is no longer needed...
...and any Physics Assembler can be used for disassembly
lang.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_simul: Simulated Contraptions have physics, and remain completely interactable when assembled
lang.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_sub_l: Disconnected sections of Simulated Contraptions will split off
A Slime Ball can be used to merge any two Simulated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.header: Generating Rotational Force using the Portable Engine
lang.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_1: The Portable Engine generates rotational force by burning fuel
lang.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_2: It can be configured to run in either direction.
lang.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_3: Fuel can be inserted by automated means
lang.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_4: Using a Blaze Cake, the Portable Engine can be superheated for additional power output
lang.simulated.ponder.redstone_accumulator.te: Redstone Accumulators store an analog signal that can be modified over time
Signals at the back increase the output strength
Signals from the sides decrease the output strength
Using the value panel, the rate of change can be configured
Configured delays can range up to an hour
lang.simulated.ponder.redstone_inductor.text_: Redstone Inductors output an analog signal that changes over time to match its input
Using the value panel, the rate of change can be configured
Configured delays can range up to an hour
lang.simulated.ponder.redstone_magnet.text_1: Redstone Magnets can attract or repel other Redstone Magnets
lang.simulated.ponder.redstone_magnet.text_4: Attracting magnets attempt to align with each other
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_connections.text_1: A pair of Rope Connectors can be attached with Rope
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_connections.text_2: A pair of Rope Winches cannot connect
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_1: Right-Clicking a Rope Winch and Connector with a Rope Coupling will attach them together
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_2: When given Rotational Force, Rope Winches reel in and out the attached rope
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_3: Shears can be used to remove the Rope
lang.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_4: Right-Click holding a wrench to slide down the Rope
lang.simulated.ponder.shared.property_tooltip: Detailed property information can be previewed in the item tooltip
Detailed property information can be previewed in the item tooltip while wearing Goggles
However, you can't preview these properties because you disabled the tooltip...
Detailed property information can be previewed in the item tooltip while pressing Shift
Detailed property information can be previewed in the item tooltip while wearing Goggles and pressing Shift
lang.simulated.ponder.steering_wheel_comparat: Redstone Comparators can be used to read the current angle of the Steering Wheel
The output Signal is proportional to the configured maximum Angle
Redstone Comparators placed on the back of the Steering Wheel will read if it is in use
lang.simulated.ponder.steering_wheel_intro.te: Steering Wheels provide precise rotational output
Hold right click to grab the wheel...
Sneaking while turning the wheel snaps to 45° intervals
The maximum turning angle can be configured using the value panel
Mind that Bearings have to be specifically told not to disassemble
Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance
lang.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_intro.he: Moving Structures using the Swivel Bearing
lang.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_intro.te: Swivel Bearings attach to the block in front of them
Use Super Glue or Honey Glue to select a group of blocks
When powered via the cog, it will assemble into a Simulated Contraption
lang.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_passthro: Passing Rotation through a Swivel Bearing
Rotational power via the Shaft passes directly through the Swivel Bearing
Rotation remains uninterrupted as the Swivel Bearing turns
lang.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_unlockin: This behavior can be configured using the value panel
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.header: Using Sails and Symmetric Sails on Simulated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_11: Unlike Regular Sails, Symmetric Sails only produce Drag
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_12: Note that when moving parallel to the direction of motion, they have no effect
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_13: When angled away from the direction of motion, Drag is applied
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_14: This can be used for turning or stabilization surfaces
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_3: When moving on a Simulated Contraption, Regular Sails provide Lift
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_4: Lift is generated relative to the speed of the Sail, and is applied perpendicular to its surface
lang.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail_windmill: Symmetric Sails are handy blocks to create Windmills with
They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
Right-Click with Dye to paint them
lang.simulated.ponder.tag.navigation_items.de: Components which offer a destination to a Navigation Table
lang.simulated.ponder.tag.physics_behavior.de: Components which have unique physics behavior or interactions
lang.simulated.ponder.tag.physics_sensors.des: Components which provide dynamic information about the world around them
lang.simulated.ponder.tag.thrust_blocks.descr: Components which produce thrust on Simulated Contraptions
lang.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.header: Controlling signals using the Throttle Lever
lang.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_1: Throttle Levers make for a compact and precise source of redstone power
lang.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_2: Right-click and drag to set its analog power output
lang.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_3: Using a Wrench, the signal can be inverted
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.header: Controlling Rotational Speed using Torsion Springs
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_1: Torsion Springs relay rotation within a set range of angles
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_2: When the input stops rotating, the Spring returns to its starting angle
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_3: The angle limit can be configured on the value panel
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_4: Mind that Bearings have to be specifically told not to disassemble
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_5: When powered by Redstone, Torsion Springs will not spring back
lang.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_6: Redstone Comparators can be used to read the current angle of the spring
lang.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_1: The Velocity Sensor outputs a redstone signal based on its speed
lang.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_2: By default, power is output away from the direction of motion
lang.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_3: The value box can configure the speed of maximum signal
lang.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_4: It can also change the output side to be towards the direction of motion
lang.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_5: Velocity is only measured through the facing axis
lang.simulated.prevent_disassembly: Disassembly from non-primary Physics Assembler prevented
lang.simulated.spring.not_enough_support: This face does not have enough support!
lang.simulated.swivel_bearing.too_fast_error: It appears that this _Swivel Bearing_ is rotating _too fast_.

zh.aeronautics.generic.push_when_clockwise: 顺时针旋转时推出空气

zh.aeronautics.ponder.burner_pressure.heade: 气压对热空气燃烧室的影响
zh.aeronautics.ponder.burner_pressure.text_: 热空气燃烧室的运作受气压影响
物理结构会在升力与重力平衡时趋于稳定

zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_1: 气囊类方块所包裹的区域在充满热空气时会产生升力
zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_2: 热空气会从上往下填充气球
zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_3: 热空气必须被气密的方块所包裹
zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_4: 可以用气球蒙皮包裹传动杆使之拥有气密性
zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_5: 气球内部的方块会减少气球的有效容积
zh.aeronautics.ponder.envelope.text_6: 手持染料右击可对其染色
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.header: 气压对陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承的影响
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_1: 陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承的运作受气压影响
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_3: 物理结构会在推力与重量平衡时趋于稳定
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_4: 因此，可以调节推力大小来改变高度
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyro_pressure.text_5: 可以用高度传感器读取气压的精确值
zh.aeronautics.ponder.gyroscopic_propeller_: 使用向下放置的陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承稳定结构
当陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承朝下放置时……
……它可以稳定住一个上重下轻的结构
使用红石信号控制陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承
有时可能要避免陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承向上倾斜
通入红石信号即可将倾斜角度重置为零
使用陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承稳定直升机
普通的螺旋桨轴承可能不太适合用于直升机
这时，你应当使用陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承
陀螺仪螺旋桨轴承会试图保持螺旋桨竖直向上
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.header: 使用热空气燃烧器产生升力
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_1: 热空气燃烧器通过向气球填充热空气来产生升力
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_2: 当被红石充能时，热空气燃烧室会逐渐为其上方的气球提供热空气
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_3: 可以使用输入面板调整最大热空气输出量
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_4: 调整红石信号输入会按比例调整所选输出量
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_5: 升力大小取决于气球的尺寸
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_6: 多个热空气燃烧器可以对同一个气球进行输出
zh.aeronautics.ponder.hot_air_burner.text_7: 出于美观目的，可以投入缠魂物品来改变火焰类型
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.header: 使用浮空水晶让结构悬浮
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_1: 当足够多的浮空水晶处于物理结构上时……
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_3: 仅凭浮空水晶，物理结构无法提升高度
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_5: 在低速运动时，浮空水晶会明显阻滞移动
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite.text_6: 这种阻力在较高运动速度下会减小
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.header: 将浮空混合物结晶成浮空水晶
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_1: 浮空混合物可以结晶成浮空水晶
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_3: 一旦结晶，浮空水晶将无法被回收
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_4: 附近的热源也可以启动结晶过程
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_5: 反应开始后，晶体将在整个流体中扩散
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_6: 当使用某些方块来铸造浮空水晶时……
zh.aeronautics.ponder.levitite_blend.text_7: ……它们在结晶过程中会被破坏
zh.aeronautics.ponder.miniprop_pressure.tex: 螺旋桨的运作受气压影响
可以用高度传感器读取气压的精确值
zh.aeronautics.ponder.mounted_potato_cannon: 使用固定式土豆加农炮
固定式土豆加农炮是土豆加农炮的方块版本
它接受与土豆加农炮相同的弹药……
……并且可以通过自动化方式装填
通入旋转力来为加农炮蓄力
加农炮蓄力完全后，通入红石信号即可开火
持续通入红石信号即可使加农炮连续自动开火
zh.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_bearing_siz: 使用螺旋桨轴承构建螺旋桨
螺旋桨轴承会黏着其正面上的方块
风帆越多的螺旋桨，产生推力的效率越高
只要包含至少 2 个有效的类风帆方块，任何结构都可以算作有效的螺旋桨
zh.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_bearing_thr: 使用螺旋桨推动物理结构
多种螺旋桨都能产生推力
推力可以推动物理结构
反转旋转方向可以反转推力方向
也可以使用扳手反转推力方向
如果螺旋桨在空气中移动，就无法提供原来那般的推力，因为空气已经在相对其运动了
……所以其输出的推力便会相应地减弱
螺旋桨的推力和气流可以用工程师护目镜查看
zh.aeronautics.ponder.propeller_pressure.he: 气压对螺旋桨轴承的影响

zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.header: 使用蒸汽喷口产生升力
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_1: 蒸汽喷口通过向气球填充蒸汽来产生升力
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_2: 当被红石充能时，蒸汽喷口会逐渐为其上方的气球提供蒸汽
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_3: 与蒸汽引擎一样，需要足够的热量、水和锅炉空间
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_4: 可以使用输入面板选择最大蒸汽输出量
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_5: 调整红石信号输入会按比例调整所选输出量
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_6: 升力大小取决于气球的尺寸
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_7: 多个蒸汽喷口可以对同一个气球进行输出
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_8: 请注意，要让多个蒸汽喷口满负荷运行，锅炉的功率等级必须满足需求
zh.aeronautics.ponder.steam_vent.text_9: 出于美观目的，可以用铁板改变金属材质

zh.block.simulated.handle.tooltip.summary: 附着在方块上，方便_抓握_。
zh.block.simulated.linked_typewriter.toolti: _开关_无线红石打字机。激活时会接管_移动控制_以及任何_已分配的按键_。
将_无线红石遥控器_的频率绑定到打字机。
启用_绑定模式_，按下_任意按键_即可将此按键与_无线红石频率_绑定。（无线红石打字机被_破坏_时，频率会被_保留_）
手持无线红石遥控器右击时
右击无线红石接收器时
通过分配的_按键_方便地控制多个_无线红石_频率。
zh.block.simulated.nameplate.tooltip.behavi: 所有铭牌将_共享并设定_该_物理结构_的名称
zh.commands.simulated.lock.success: 已更新 %s 物理结构 %s 的锁定状态
zh.generator.simulated.airship_ready.info: 一个位于 y=63 的超平坦世界，用于模拟正常气压条件。
zh.item.simulated.contraption_diagram.toolt: 使作用在_物理结构_上的力_可视化_
一份包含_物理结构_详细信息的_可视化图解_。
zh.item.simulated.creative_physics_staff.to: 目标结构将被_锁定在当前位置_。
_切换为拖拽模式_，使_目标结构_随手杖移动。
使用手杖旋转_目标结构_。
调整与_被拖拽_的_目标结构_之间的_距离_
用于操控_物理结构_的_创造模式_工具。
_发射_一个带绳索的_皮搋子_。射出的一对皮搋子将_相互连接_，并_将附着的方块拉到一起_。
使用背罐中的_压缩空气_来_抵消_皮搋子发射器的_耐久_消耗
咻！利用吸力牵引_物理结构_。可通过_背罐_提供的_压缩空气_供能。
zh.item.simulated.spring.tooltip.summary: 嘣！用_弹簧连接_两个方块。
zh.simulated.analog_transmission.too_fast_e: 该_模拟传动器_似乎试图超过_最大转速_。请减弱或移除通入的_红石信号_以使其减速。
zh.simulated.auger_shaft.actor_items: 含有来自元件的 %1$s 个物品
zh.simulated.contraption_diagram.cannot_use: 该图解必须放在物理结构上才能查看……
zh.simulated.generic.pull_when_clockwise: 顺时针旋转时吸入空气
zh.simulated.generic.push_when_clockwise: 顺时针旋转时推出空气
zh.simulated.gui.altitude_sensor.title: 配置信号范围
zh.simulated.gui.assembly.exception.couldNo: 无法对准物理结构进行拆卸！
zh.simulated.gui.assembly.exception.sameSub: 无法拆解到同一个物理结构上！
zh.simulated.gui.assembly.exception.tooFarF: 距离地面过远，无法拆卸！
zh.simulated.gui.assembly.exception.tooFast: 移动速度过快，无法拆卸！
zh.simulated.linked_typewriter.bind_item: 按下任意按键，绑定此频率到该按键上
zh.simulated.linked_typewriter.confirm_dele: 这将删除当前所有按键绑定。再次单击以确认。
zh.simulated.linked_typewriter.linked_contr: 已添加无线红石遥控器绑定的按键
zh.simulated.linked_typewriter.press_keybin: 按任意键将此遥控器的频率绑定至无线红石打字机
zh.simulated.linked_typewriter.title: 无线红石打字机
zh.simulated.merging_glue.invalid_direction: 不能将两个朝下的面胶合到一起！
不能将垂直面和水平面胶合在一起！
不能将两个朝上的面胶合到一起！
zh.simulated.merging_glue.only_between_sub_: 只能在物理结构之间进行黏合！
zh.simulated.merging_glue.same_sub_level: 不能黏合在同一个物理结构上！
zh.simulated.ponder.altitude_sensor_into.te: 高度传感器根据其高度输出红石信号
默认情况下，向上移动会提升信号强度
可在面板中更改最小高度与最大高度
它还可以设置为向上移动时降低信号强度
佩戴工程师护目镜时，可以看到气压和精确的高度信息
可以使用扳手查看更精确的高度变化
zh.simulated.ponder.analog_transmission.hea: 使用模拟传动器控制转速
zh.simulated.ponder.analog_transmission.tex: 无信号输入的模拟传动器表现与齿轮箱完全相同
模拟红石输入会减慢齿轮相对于传动杆的转速
更高的信号强度会产生更大的传动比
当传动器通过齿轮获得输入时，传动杆则会加速
在满信号输入或传动杆的速度将要超过转速上限时，传动杆和齿轮会分离……
使用螺旋传动杆从采集元件中提取物品
螺旋传动杆从采集元件收集材料
同一水平面内的所有元件均包含在内
当连接的元件破坏方块时……
zh.simulated.ponder.auger_shaft_intro.text_: 通入旋转力的螺旋传动杆将会运输物品，也会从元件中提取物品
使用扳手，你可以在螺旋传动杆和螺旋齿轮之间切换
可以使用工业铁块封装螺旋传动杆
要观察物品流，可以查看螺旋齿轮上的指示器……
……或者佩戴护目镜查看螺旋方向
物品不能从螺旋齿轮置入或取出……
zh.simulated.ponder.directional_gearshift.h: 使用定向齿轮换向器控制旋转方向
zh.simulated.ponder.directional_gearshift.t: 无信号输入的定向齿轮换向器不会传递旋转力
当直输端被红石充能时，它将传递旋转
当反转端被红石充能时，它将反转旋转
当两端都被红石充能时，它将停止传递旋转
zh.simulated.ponder.directional_receiver.he: 使用定向无线红石接收器
zh.simulated.ponder.directional_receiver.te: 定向无线红石接收器可以检测与附近无线红石信号终端的角度
正前方的无线红石信号终端的信号将以完整信号强度被接收
角度越小，接收到的信号强度越低
定向无线红石接收器无法从后方的无线红石信号终端接收信号
定向无线红石接收器遵循与无线红石信号终端相同的物品频率机制
zh.simulated.ponder.docking_connector.text_: 对接连接器可以成对地创建刚性连接
伸出的连接器会尝试对齐
一旦完全对齐，连接器就会锁定在一起
这种连接是刚性的，但保持两侧相互独立
锁定后，物品和流体可以双向传输
置入和提取必须在两侧分别进行
任一连接器都可以缩回以解除对接
红石比较器可用于读取对接进度
zh.simulated.ponder.gimbal_sensor_intro.tex: 姿态传感器根据其朝向输出红石信号
默认情况下，信号向下方发出
数值框可以配置满格信号对应的角度……
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.header: 使用蜂蜜胶来黏合方块
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_1: 在物理结构中，蜂蜜胶是强力胶的便捷替代品
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_2: 右击两个端点来创建一个新的“胶合”区域……
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_3: ……可以按住 Ctrl 并滚动鼠标滚轮以扩大或缩小
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_4: 或者，按住 Alt 将端点放在空中
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_6: ……蜂蜜胶不能用于黏合动态结构
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_intro.text_7: 它专门用来黏合物理结构
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_super_glue.h: 同时使用蜂蜜胶与强力胶
zh.simulated.ponder.honey_glue_super_glue.t: 对于更复杂的物理结构……
……强力胶可能会形成不需要的连接
在这种情况下，蜂蜜胶可能更合适
组装时，蜂蜜胶会附着在重叠的强力胶上
但是，强力胶不会附着在重叠的蜂蜜胶上
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.header: 使用激光指示器与激光传感器
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_1: 激光指示器在被红石充能时会发射激光
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_3: 激光传感器可在未被阻挡时检测激光
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_4: 它会根据激光强度输出信号
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_6: ……只有颜色匹配的激光才会激活传感器
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_7: 用扳手右击正面或背面会反转红石充能的逻辑
zh.simulated.ponder.laser_pointer.text_8: 最大投射距离可以在背面调整
zh.simulated.ponder.modulating_receiver.hea: 使用调制无线红石接收器
zh.simulated.ponder.modulating_receiver.tex: 调制无线红石接收器可以检测到与附近无线红石信号终端的距离
在最小范围内的无线红石信号终端的信号将以完整信号强度被接收
超出最大范围的无线红石信号终端的信号将不会被接收
而介于两者之间的终端信号，则接收等比例衰减后的信号强度
调制无线红石接收器遵循与无线红石信号终端相同的物品频率机制
zh.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_1: 导航台为导航物品提供红石反馈
zh.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_3: ……它将向目的地方向发出红石信号
zh.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_4: 若非正对目的地，红石信号会较弱
zh.simulated.ponder.navigation_table.text_5: 不同的导航物品提供独特的目标
zh.simulated.ponder.nozzle.header: 使用分散网移动物理结构
zh.simulated.ponder.nozzle.text_1: 为物理结构上鼓风机安装分散网后，它会根据附近的面来为物理结构施加推力
zh.simulated.ponder.nozzle.text_2: 结构会被附近的墙壁在水平方向上推开
zh.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_1: 光学传感器可以检测阻挡其激光指示器的方块
zh.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_2: 当检测到方块时，会发出红石信号
zh.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_3: 光学传感器的信号强度与其检测到的方块距离相关
zh.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_4: 最大距离可以通过数值面板配置
zh.simulated.ponder.optical_sensor.text_6: ……只有匹配的方块才会发出信号
zh.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_block: 某些方块的重量可能不同……
zh.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_intro: 物理组装器将方块组装成物理结构
使用强力胶或蜂蜜胶选择一组方块……
……然后按住右键并拉动拉杆以组装
注意对角线相接的方块也包括在内
组装完成后，原有的物理组装器不再需要……
……任何物理组装器都可用于拆卸
zh.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_simul: 物理结构具有物理效果，组装后仍可完全交互
zh.simulated.ponder.physics_assembler_sub_l: 物理结构中断开连接的部分将会分离
黏液球可用于合并任意两个物理结构
zh.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.header: 使用便携式引擎产生旋转力
zh.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_1: 便携式引擎通过燃烧燃料产生旋转力
zh.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_2: 它可以配置为沿任一方向运行。
zh.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_3: 燃料可以通过自动化方式输入
zh.simulated.ponder.portable_engine.text_4: 使用烈焰蛋糕，便携式引擎可以进行超级加热以获得额外的动力输出
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_accumulator.he: 使用红石累加器控制信号
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_accumulator.te: 红石累加器存储着可随时间进行变动的模拟信号
从背面输入的信号将增加输出强度
从侧面输入的信号将减小输出强度
使用数值面板，可以配置变化速率
配置的延迟最长可达一小时
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_inductor.heade: 使用红石自感器控制信号
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_inductor.text_: 红石自感器会输出一个随时间变化的模拟信号，以匹配其输入信号
使用数值面板，可以配置变化速率
配置的延迟最长可达一小时
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_magnet.text_1: 红石磁铁可以吸引或排斥其他红石磁铁
zh.simulated.ponder.redstone_magnet.text_4: 相吸的磁铁会尝试相互对齐
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_connections.text_1: 可以用绳索连接一对绳索连接器
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_connections.text_2: 不能连接一对绳索绞盘
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.header: 使用绳索连接物理结构
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_1: 手持绳索右击绳索绞盘和连接器，可将它们连接在一起
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_2: 当获得旋转力时，绳索绞盘会收放连接的绳索
zh.simulated.ponder.rope_intro.text_4: 手持扳手右击可沿绳索滑下
zh.simulated.ponder.shared.property_tooltip: 详细的属性信息可以在物品提示框中预览
佩戴护目镜时，详细的属性信息可以在物品提示框中预览
然而，你无法预览这些属性，因为你禁用了提示框……
按住 Shift 时，详细的属性信息可以在物品提示框中预览
佩戴护目镜且按住 Shift 时，详细的属性信息可以在物品提示框中预览
zh.simulated.ponder.steering_wheel_comparat: 使用比较器读取舵轮信息
红石比较器可用于读取舵轮的当前角度
输出信号与配置的最大角度成比例
放置在舵轮背面的红石比较器会读取其是否正在被使用
zh.simulated.ponder.steering_wheel_intro.te: 舵轮可提供精确的旋转输出
转动舵轮时潜行可使其以 45° 为间隔步进
最大转动角度可以通过数值面板配置
记得调好轴承模式，别让结构变回了方块
对舵轮使用木板以改变其外观
zh.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_intro.he: 使用物理轴承移动结构
zh.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_intro.te: 物理轴承会黏着其正面上的方块
使用强力胶或蜂蜜胶选择一组方块
当通过齿轮提供动力时，它将组装成物理结构
zh.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_passthro: 通过物理轴承传递旋转
通过传动杆传递的旋转力可直接穿过物理轴承
物理轴承转动时，传动不会中断
zh.simulated.ponder.swivel_bearing_unlockin: ……物理轴承会被解锁，其上的结构将被允许自由旋转
此行为可以通过数值面板配置
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.header: 在物理结构上使用风帆和对称风帆
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_11: 与普通风帆不同，对称风帆只产生阻力
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_12: 请注意，当平行于运动方向移动时，它们没有效果
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_13: 当与运动方向成一定角度时，会施加阻力
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_14: 这可用于转向或稳定翼面
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_3: 当物理结构移动时，普通风帆会提供升力
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail.text_4: 升力根据风帆的速度产生，并垂直于其表面施加
zh.simulated.ponder.symmetric_sail_windmill: 使用对称风帆组装风车
对称风帆是组装风车的便利方块
无需强力胶等黏合手段，它们也可以自行相互连接
手持染料右击来为它们染色
zh.simulated.ponder.tag.navigation_items.de: 为导航台提供目标地的组件
zh.simulated.ponder.tag.physics_behavior.de: 具有独特物理行为或交互的组件
zh.simulated.ponder.tag.physics_sensors.des: 提供周围世界动态信息的组件
zh.simulated.ponder.tag.thrust_blocks.descr: 能够为物理结构提供推力的组件
zh.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.header: 使用油门拉杆控制信号
zh.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_1: 油门拉杆可作为紧凑而精确的红石信号源
zh.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_2: 右击并拖拽以设置其模拟信号输出
zh.simulated.ponder.throttle_lever.text_3: 使用扳手可以反转信号
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.header: 使用扭力弹簧控制转速
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_1: 扭力弹簧在设定的角度范围内传递旋转
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_2: 当输入停止旋转时，弹簧会返回到起始角度
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_3: 角度限制可以在数值面板上配置
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_4: 记得调好轴承模式，别让结构变回了方块
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_5: 当被红石充能时，扭力弹簧不会复位
zh.simulated.ponder.torsion_spring.text_6: 红石比较器可用于读取弹簧的当前角度
zh.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_1: 速度传感器根据其速度输出红石信号
zh.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_2: 默认情况下，红石信号向运动方向的反方向输出
zh.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_3: 数值框可以配置满格信号对应的速度值
zh.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_4: 它也可以更改为向运动方向输出
zh.simulated.ponder.velocity_sensor.text_5: 仅测量其朝向面的分速度
zh.simulated.prevent_disassembly: 已阻止通过非主物理组装器拆卸
zh.simulated.subtitle.block.absorber.eats: 无法确定来源的译文，请联系本地化团队
zh.simulated.swivel_bearing.too_fast_error: 该_物理轴承_的转速似乎_过快_。
zh.stat.simulated.interact_with_assembler: 与物理组装器交互次数
zh.stat.simulated.portable_engines_fed: 向便携式引擎填充燃料次数

items.aeroencasedpipe:light_gray_envelope_enca: Light Gray Envelope Encased Fluid Pipe

lang.tooltip.ballastmod.ballast_stones: Has more mass with each added layer!

lang.item.aeroengineering.coordinate_form.too: Records a _target position_ and _landing heading_ for flight navigation.
Opens the form to enter _X, Y and Z coordinates_ and select a _target heading_.
When inserted into a Navigation Table
Shows the _target_, _guidance line_ and _landing heading line_ on the Pilot Helmet navigation HUD.
lang.tooltip.aeroengineering.engine_placement: Look at an engine core block to use placement assist.
lang.tooltip.aeroengineering.engine_exhaust_n: Look at an Exhaust Cone, Afterburner, or Vector Bearing to use placement assist.
lang.block.aeroengineering.gas_turbine_gearbo: Converts Combustor power into _constant-speed rotational power_.
When bound to a started Combustor
Outputs a constant _64 RPM_. Stress capacity matches the Engine Gearbox at idle and rises with redstone power up to _1024_.
A Combustor can bind to only _one Gearbox of any type_.
When attached to a complete engine
Changes the engine type to _Gas Turbine_. Its fan produces no thrust, airflow, or particles.

When attached to a complete engine
Changes the engine type to _Turboshaft Engine_. Its fan produces no thrust, airflow, or particles.

Press _[H]_ to open the helmet configuration panel, manage bound devices, and choose displayed information. The HUD shows data from enabled targets. Navigation display requires both a _speedometer_ and a _navigation station_ to be bound.

lang.aeroengineering.ponder.basic_turbofan_en: Assemble the five-block engine core from intake to exhaust.
The Engine Fan sits at the intake end.
The Compressor is placed directly behind the fan.
The Combustor sits in the middle and burns Aviation Kerosene.
The Turbine is installed behind the combustor.
The Exhaust Cone finishes the basic five-block core.
When all five blocks are ordered and facing correctly, the engine can run.
Fluid systems can deliver Aviation Kerosene.
Shift-right-click the Combustor to configure redstone frequencies and the step size for increasing or decreasing engine power.
Configure the redstone frequency that switches thrust reverser on.
Bind an Engine Gearbox to the Combustor, then place it within the surrounding 3x3x3 area. It outputs kinetic stress capacity while the Combustor is started.
Without casing, the engine spins and produces thrust.
Engine Casing can encase fluid pipes near the engine.
Engine Casing and its three copycat variants can surround the core and greatly increase thrust.
An Exhaust Nozzle ring or any of its three copycat variants gives extra thrust.
When the Thrust Reverser is switched on, it produces small reverse thrust.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.high_bypass_turbo: Build a high-bypass turbofan by replacing the intake Engine Fan with a Large Engine Fan.
The Large Engine Fan sits at the intake end and provides the bypass airflow.
The Compressor still sits directly behind the fan.
The Combustor burns Aviation Kerosene in the engine core.
The rest of the five-block turbofan core remains Compressor, Combustor, Turbine, and Exhaust Cone.
Fuel delivery works the same as a normal turbofan.
Configure the Combustor frequencies and power step just like the basic turbofan.
Bind an Engine Gearbox to the Combustor, then place it within the surrounding 3x3x3 area. It outputs kinetic stress capacity while the Combustor is started.
Without casing, the high-bypass turbofan already spins and produces thrust.
The Large Engine Fan does not need a surrounding casing ring to keep the engine casing complete.
Casing starts behind the Large Engine Fan, around the Compressor and hot core, and still increases thrust.
An Exhaust Nozzle ring behind the engine adds more thrust.
High-bypass turbofans can use the Exhaust Cone thrust reverser frequency.
When reverse thrust is active, the airflow points forward and produces small reverse thrust.
Right-click the Large Engine Fan, then scroll its value box to change propeller size.
Scrolling the value up makes the Large Engine Fan visibly larger.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.afterburning_turb: Assemble the afterburning engine core from intake to exhaust.
The Engine Fan sits at the intake end.
The Compressor is placed directly behind the fan.
The Combustor sits in the middle and burns Aviation Kerosene.
The Turbine is installed behind the combustor.
Use an Afterburner instead of the Exhaust Cone to build an afterburning turbofan core.
This core can run normally, then switch to afterburning when signalled.
Fluid systems can deliver Aviation Kerosene.
Configure the redstone frequencies and power step used to raise or lower engine power.
Bind an Engine Gearbox to the Combustor, then place it within the surrounding 3x3x3 area. It outputs kinetic stress capacity while the Combustor is started.
Configure the redstone frequency that switches the Afterburner on.
Without casing, the engine spins and produces thrust.
Engine Casing can encase fluid pipes near the engine.
Engine Casing and its three copycat variants can surround the core and greatly increase thrust.
Afterburning engines can use a matching Exhaust Nozzle ring or any of its three copycat variants.
When the Afterburner is switched on, it produces enormous thrust and burns Aviation Kerosene much faster.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.variable_airflow_: Variable Airflow Afterburning Turbofan Engine Operation
Assemble the variable airflow afterburning engine core from intake to exhaust.
The Engine Fan sits at the intake end.
The Compressor is placed directly behind the fan.
The Combustor sits in the middle and burns Aviation Kerosene.
The Turbine is installed behind the combustor.
Use a Variable Airflow Afterburner behind the turbine to enable adjustable exhaust flow.
Attach a Variable Airflow Nozzle directly behind it; this replaces the normal nozzle ring.
The nozzle reads the Combustor's signal and animates its blades to match engine power.
Fluid systems can deliver Aviation Kerosene.
Configure the redstone frequencies and power step used to raise or lower engine power.
Bind an Engine Gearbox to the Combustor, then place it within the surrounding 3x3x3 area. It outputs kinetic stress capacity while the Combustor is started.
Configure the afterburner frequency separately; when it is active, the nozzle opens fully.
Without casing, the engine spins and produces thrust.
Engine Casing can encase fluid pipes near the engine.
Engine Casing and its three copycat variants can surround the core and greatly increase thrust.
A complete Variable Airflow Nozzle changes its opening with the Combustor's current signal strength.
Signal strength 3 keeps the nozzle wide and the exhaust broad for low power.
Signal strength 9 narrows the nozzle and strengthens the exhaust stream.
Signal strength 15 closes the nozzle furthest and produces the strongest normal airflow.
When afterburning is switched on, the afterburner beam takes over and the nozzle opens for maximum flow.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.vector_afterburni: Assemble the vectoring afterburning engine core from intake to exhaust.
The Engine Fan sits at the intake end.
The Compressor is placed directly behind the fan.
The Combustor sits in the middle and burns Aviation Kerosene.
The Turbine is installed behind the combustor.
Install the vectoring afterburner mechanism behind the turbine to control thrust direction and afterburning.
The core can run normally while the vectoring mechanism controls exhaust direction and afterburning.
Fluid systems can deliver Aviation Kerosene.
Configure the redstone frequencies and power step used to start the engine and change its power.
Bind an Engine Gearbox to the Combustor, then place it within the surrounding 3x3x3 area. It outputs kinetic stress capacity while the Combustor is started.
Configure four vector direction frequencies and an independent afterburner frequency.
Without casing, the engine spins and produces thrust.
Engine Casing can encase fluid pipes near the engine.
Engine Casing and its three copycat variants can surround the core and greatly increase thrust.
The Exhaust Nozzle and its three copycat variants can form the tilting ring, and exhaust particles follow it.
Afterburning produces enormous thrust and consumes fuel faster while the exhaust follows the tilted nozzle.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.airborne_radar.te: The Airborne Radar scans nearby physicalized Sable structures.
The Radar needs external kinetic stress. Connect power to its shaft axis before it can scan.
It consumes kinetic stress; higher absolute rotation speed gives a longer scan range.
Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to open the fire-control frequency menu.
The menu has three redstone-link frequency pairs: Switch, Confirm, and Launch.
Switch Target cycles the tracked target among valid fire-control contacts while no target is confirmed.
Confirm / Cancel locks the tracked target. Trigger it again to cancel the confirmed lock.
Launch Missile fires one ready bound launcher at the confirmed target, then clears the lock.
Fire-control contacts must be inside radar range and inside the forward aim cone.
A nearby Velocity Sensor supplies the preferred forward direction; otherwise the radar uses structure motion, then block facing.
Right-click the Radar with a single Missile Assembly Station item to reserve and bind a launcher slot. A Radar can bind up to 8 stations.
Place the bound station. It registers with the Radar and can launch ready assembled missiles.
Wrench a bound station to highlight the Radar it belongs to.
The bound Radar is highlighted so you can find and manage the launcher connection.
Open the Radar menu and press Reset Launchers to clear every reserved or placed launcher binding.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.hud_display.text_: Place the HUD Display directly above the Simulated Linked Typewriter, in front of a Create Seat.
Sneak-right-click the Display with a configured Pilot Helmet to copy the helmet HUD data onto the screen.
The Display renders the same enabled HUD instruments and monitor entries as the helmet.
Bind engine and weapon blocks, such as a Combustor and Missile Assembly Station, to show power state and launcher loadout.
Bind a Navigation Table, Velocity Sensor, Gimbal Sensor, and Altitude Sensor for navigation and flight instruments.
When the copied helmet data includes an Airborne Radar, fire-control contacts appear on the HUD Display.
Nearby physicalized structures become radar contacts behind the pilot's forward view.
As contacts move, the HUD Display updates their relative positions.
Trigger the Switch Target frequency to move the tracked target marker between contacts.
Trigger Confirm / Cancel to turn the tracked marker into a confirmed fire-control lock.
Trigger Launch Missile after confirming a target; the HUD Display clears or changes the lock as fire control updates.
If no copied helmet data is present, the screen shows the empty HUD message instead.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.missile_assembly_: Right-click the Radar with a Missile Assembly Station item to bind a launcher slot before placing it.
Build a multi-block missile directly below the station. Light gray concrete is enough for this example.
Use Super Glue to frame the missile body so the station can assemble the whole glued structure.
Right-click the station with a Missile Thruster. The thruster mounts below the station and carries the assembled missile.
The Lever is placed one block above the Assembly Station.
Power the station with redstone, such as a Lever, to assemble the glued missile body onto the thruster.
After assembly, the station is loaded and the bound Radar can launch it when fire control sends Launch Missile.
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.pilot_helmet.head: Binding and configuring the Pilot Helmet
lang.aeroengineering.ponder.pilot_helmet.text: Targets must be inside the same physicalized Sable structure.
Hold the Pilot Helmet and sneak-right-click a readable block to bind it.
Repeat this on other blocks in that structure. Sneak-right-click a bound block again to remove it.
Equip the helmet, then press the HUD manager key (H by default).
Select a target to rename it, hide it, or choose which information entries it displays.
Dynamic HUD instruments use Altitude, Velocity, Gimbal, and Navigation targets.
Engine blocks still use normal information panels; they do not create flight instruments.
The Altitude Sensor supplies the altitude tape on the dynamic HUD.
The Velocity Sensor supplies speed and heading. Reverse its positive direction when the HUD direction does not match the physical structure.
The Gimbal Sensor supplies pitch and roll. Swap the pitch and roll axes when their HUD directions do not match the physical structure.
The Navigation Table still accepts its normal targets, including compasses, recovery compasses, maps, and redstone magnets.
It also accepts a configured Coordinate Form as a waypoint target.
A Coordinate Form adds a target approach heading to the HUD. Bind a Velocity Sensor as well so the HUD can compare the structure's heading with the approach direction.
The HUD manager can toggle dynamic instruments, resize them, and apply the direction corrections for each matching sensor.
A helmet supports up to 12 targets, all belonging to one physical structure.

燃烧室最大功率时开启加力后会获得巨大推力并更快消耗航空煤油，尾焰仍会沿倾斜喷口喷射
zh.aeroengineering.ponder.airborne_radar.te: 机载雷达会扫描附近已经物理化的 Sable 结构
雷达需要外界接入应力；先沿其传动轴方向接入动力，雷达才能开始扫描
雷达会消耗应力；绝对转速越高，扫描距离越远
空手潜行右击雷达，可以打开火控频率菜单
菜单中有三组红石链接频率：切换、确认和发射
切换目标频率会在有效火控目标之间切换当前跟踪目标；已确认目标时不会切换
确认/取消频率会锁定当前跟踪目标；再次触发会取消已确认锁定
发射导弹频率会让一个已绑定且就绪的发射器攻击已确认目标，随后清除锁定
火控目标必须位于雷达范围内，并进入雷达前方的瞄准锥
附近的速度传感器会提供优先前向；否则雷达会依次使用结构运动方向和方块朝向
手持单个导弹挂架右击雷达，可以预留并绑定一个发射器槽位；每个雷达最多绑定 8 个挂架
放置已绑定的挂架后，它会注册到雷达，并可发射已经装配完成的导弹
用扳手点击已绑定的挂架可高亮其所属雷达
被绑定的雷达会被高亮，方便找到并管理该发射器连接
打开雷达菜单并点击重置挂架按钮，可以清除所有已预留或已放置的发射器绑定
zh.aeroengineering.ponder.hud_display.text_: 将 HUD 显示屏直接放在 Simulated 链接打字机上方，并让它位于机械动力坐垫前方
手持已配置的飞行员头盔，潜行右击显示屏，可将头盔 HUD 数据复制到屏幕上
显示屏会渲染与头盔相同的已启用 HUD 仪表和监控信息
绑定燃烧室和导弹挂架等发动机与武器方块，可以显示工况状态和挂架载荷
绑定导航台、速度表、姿态传感器和高度传感器，可以显示导航与飞行仪表
复制的头盔数据包含机载雷达时，火控目标会出现在 HUD 显示屏上
附近已经物理化的结构会成为雷达目标，显示在飞行员前方视野中
目标移动时，HUD 显示屏会更新它们的相对位置
触发切换目标频率，会在多个接触目标之间移动跟踪标记
触发确认/取消频率，会将跟踪标记变为已确认的火控锁定
确认目标后触发发射导弹频率；火控更新时，HUD 显示屏会清除或改变锁定状态
如果没有复制头盔数据，屏幕会显示无 HUD 数据提示
zh.aeroengineering.ponder.missile_assembly_: 放置前，手持导弹挂架右击雷达，先绑定一个发射器槽位
放置已绑定的导弹挂架
在挂架正下方搭建多方块导弹；示例中使用淡灰色混凝土
使用强力胶框选导弹本体，让挂架能把整段粘连结构装配起来
手持导弹推进器右击挂架，推进器会挂载在挂架下方并承载已装配导弹
拉杆放在导弹挂架正上方一格
用拉杆等红石信号激活挂架，将粘连的导弹本体装配到推进器上
装配完成后，挂架进入已装载状态；绑定雷达收到发射信号时即可发射
zh.aeroengineering.ponder.pilot_helmet.head: 飞行员头盔的绑定与 HUD 设置
zh.aeroengineering.ponder.pilot_helmet.text: 监控目标必须位于同一个已经物理化的 Sable 结构中
手持飞行员头盔，潜行右击可读取信息的方块即可绑定
可以继续绑定该结构中的其他方块；再次潜行右击已绑定方块可将其移除
装备头盔后，按 HUD 管理键打开界面（默认为 H）
选择一个目标后，可以重命名、隐藏目标，或选择需要显示的信息项目
动态飞行 HUD 使用高度传感器、速度传感器、姿态传感器和导航桌目标
发动机方块使用普通信息面板，不会生成飞行仪表
高度传感器为动态 HUD 提供高度刻度表
速度传感器为 HUD 提供速度和航向如果 HUD 正方向与物理结构不一致，可以反转速度表的正方向
姿态传感器为 HUD 提供俯仰角和滚转角如果 HUD 方向与物理结构不一致，可以交换俯仰轴与滚转轴
导航台仍可接受原有导航目标，包括指南针、追溯指针、地图
导航台还可以接受已经填写的坐标表单作为航点目标
坐标表单会额外在 HUD 中提供目标进近航向还需绑定速度传感器，HUD 才能比较物理结构航向与进近方向
HUD 管理界面可以开关动态仪表、调整大小，并为对应传感器应用方向修正
一个头盔最多绑定 12 个目标，并且所有目标必须属于同一个物理结构

lang.createpropulsion.ponder.shared.thruster_: Thrusters accept configured fuels through connected pipes.
Invalid fluids do not power the thruster.
Use valid thruster fuels in the input line.
Now apply redstone power so the thruster actually produces thrust.
2x2 multiblocks only accept fluid from the rear intake side.
A 2x2x2 multiblock is built from 8 normal thrusters.
First line (no clutch) is invalid here: it is not pumping into the rear intake.
Because this line does not feed the rear tanks, the thruster does nothing.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
Remove the invalid top line and feed from the rear side instead.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
With the valid rear-fed line, insert proper thruster fuel.
Finally apply redstone to the thruster: now it actually runs.
3x3 multiblocks follow the same rear-intake-only rule.
A 3x3x3 multiblock is built from 27 normal thrusters.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
Feed the back layer input manifold for full operation.
Insert valid thruster fuel into the rear-fed manifold.
Apply redstone to the thruster and the whole multiblock works.
lang.createpropulsion.ponder.shared.vector_th: Vector Thruster uses Forge energy to produce thrust.
Forge energy is stored in the thruster's internal energy storage.
Currently %s FE is able to be stored in the thruster's internal storage.
Generators can power from below, this can be anything that uses forge energy system.
Vector Thrusters can rotate in all directions, this is controlled by redstone signals directly embedded into the thruster itself.
A redstone power can be anything from 0-15, this will increase the distance of rotation from the base.
Each side except front and back has a redstone signal place, that direction is where it will be rotated towards when that signal is powered.
Powering a thruster is easy, any external signal to the thruster will be the power, this can range from 0-15, and will use power accordingly.
Creative Vector Thrusters produce configurable thrust without fuel or Forge energy.
Set the creative thrust amount from the value box on the bottom of the thruster.
Creative Vector Thrusters still use redstone power as their throttle, from 0-15.
Liquid Vector Thrusters vector their thrust like normal vector thrusters, but run on pumped liquid fuel.
Pump valid thruster fuel into the liquid vector thruster through the pipe below.
Once fuel is pumped in, the internal tank can feed the thruster while it is powered.
Apply redstone power to throttle the liquid vector thruster, from 0-15.

zh.createpropulsion.ponder.shared.vector_th: 矢量推进器使用 FE 产生推力。

发电机可以从下方提供 FE，其他能够提供 FE 的元件也可以。

液体矢量推进器像普通矢量推进器一样，可以改变推力方向，但靠泵送的液体燃料运行。
通过下方的管道将有效的推进器燃料泵入液体矢量推进器。

lang.aeroworks.ponder.console_mounting.text_6: They will keep their settings when removed

lang.aeroworks.ponder.mechanical_servo.text_2: Right-click to configure its rotation range
lang.aeroworks.ponder.mechanical_servo.text_3: At full signal strength, the Servo rotates to the end of its range
lang.aeroworks.ponder.mechanical_servo.text_4: The Servo rotates to an angle proportional to the signal strength
lang.aeroworks.ponder.mechanical_servo.text_5: The Servo finishes its current rotation before it responds to a new signal

With both sides powered, the Servo has no target and holds its position

zh.aeroworks.ponder.stepper_servo.text_2: 右击以设置每一步的角度

zh.aeroworks.ponder.stepper_servo.text_5: 之后才会转向新的目标

一侧的信号使其向一个方向旋转
另一侧的信号使其向相反方向旋转
两侧同时充能时，舵机没有目标并保持当前位置

lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_crafting/: Using the Basin Foundry Lid
Basin Foundry Lids are used to melt down metals for cannon casting.
They must be heated to process melting recipes.
Boring Holes in Cast Cannons
Cannon Drills are used to bore out cast cannons.
In addition to rotational force, they require water to operate, and consume more as they speed up.
The speed of the drill must match the speed of the lathe to do work.
Bored cannon blocks drop scrap items.
Building Built-Up Cannons
Cannon Builders are used to put together the layers of built-up cannons.
Pulse the Cannon Builder with power to toggle its attachment state.
When grabbing layers from built-up blocks, the outermost layer will always be grabbed
Cannon Casting
Cannon Casts are the first block recipe for cannon blocks.
It is possible to automate the removal of finished casts.
Smaller cannons such as autocannons shed the casting sand automatically.
Use a cannon mould to build a cast layer.
Deployers can also interact with cannon casts.
Fill the cast with molten metal to start the casting process.
Cannon casts output a signal that can be read by comparators.
They output a signal from 0 to 14 measuring how full the cast is, and 15 when the cast is finished.
After being completely filled up, the cannon cast takes some time to solidify.
The time it takes for the casting process to finish depends on the size of the cast.
The finished cannon cast can be removed by breaking or interacting with it.
Using the Cannon Welder
Cannon blocks placed in survival will not connect to other cannon blocks.
The Cannon Welder can quickly connect two cannon blocks at a time.
Right-click two adjacent cannon blocks to weld them together.
The cannon blocks must align, connect, have the same material, and have the same cannon type.
Invalid
By default, the Cannon Welder cannot weld some cannon materials and/or types together.
The Cannon Welder can weld different types of cannon.
Welding cannon blocks together can weaken certain types of cannon.
It is recommended to craft and move cannon pieces in their entirety instead.
Finishing Built-Up Cannons
Blasting built-up cannon layers turns them into built-up cannon blocks.
The process works similar to bulk blasting of items, using a fan blowing into a lava block to produce a heating current.
A built-up cannon block must have all the correct layers to be transformed.
It takes a while for the cannon layers to transform into cannon blocks.
Incomplete Cannon Blocks
Some bored cannon blocks need additional items to be completed.
These are usually cannon breech blocks.
Use the listed items on the block to complete it.
Deployers can also complete incomplete cannon blocks.
Creating a Quick-Firing Breech
Use a Quick-Firing Mechanism to convert a Sliding Breech into a Quick-Firing Breech.
Deployers can also be used to create Quick-Firing Breeches.
Wrench a Quick-Firing Breech to revert it back to a Sliding Breech.
Moving Cannons Around
By default, most cast cannons will turn into scrap when broken without a Silk Touch pickaxe.
Create's contraptions can be used in varying ways to move cannons.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_kinetics/: Mechanical Arms can be used to reload the Quick-Firing Breech.
Right-click the Cannon Mount to set the arm's output.
The Quick-Firing Breech must be closed in order for the arm to operate.
The arm will not load the big cannon if the breech is open.
Once the cannon fires, the arm will automatically extract empty cartridges when provided a deposit area.
Deposit areas should have an empty Big Cartridge filter to avoid item mismanagement.
The Quick-Firing Breech allows fast reloading of assembled big cannons.
The Quick-Firing Breech can be opened and closed by right clicking the side of the breech.
First, load the projectile by right clicking the open side of the breech.
Then load the propellant and close the breech.
Big Cartridges are recommended for faster reloading.
The big cannon can then be fired.
Remaining munitions such as spent Big Cartridge cases will be automatically ejected.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/ba: Loading Big Cannons with base Create contraptions
Mechanical Pistons, Gantries, and Rope Pulleys can also load big cannons.
Munition blocks can be pulled out of big cannons depending on the connectivity of certain blocks.
Unlike the Cannon Loader, other blocks can still be attached to the contraption.
This does not affect cannon loading in any way, although only aligned munition blocks can be inserted into big cannons.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/ha: Handloading tools are convenient for loading big cannons.
Munitions can also be inserted directly into assembled big cannons.
Handloading tools can also interact with assembled big cannons.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/lo: Cannon Loaders work like Mechanical Pistons, using Piston Extension Poles to extend their range.
They must be outfitted with a head to be useful, such as a Ram Head or a Worm Head.
Under normal circumstances, the Ram Head should be used.
However, the Worm Head can be attached if the cannon needs to be unjammed.
Before reloading a cannon, it must be disassembled.
When loading a cannon, the loader mechanism, munitions, and cannon must all be in line on the same axis.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/ass: Big cannons need to be placed on cannon mounts to be assembled.
To assemble a cannon, power the hammer face with a redstone signal.
Power the Cannon Mount to aim the cannon up and down...
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/cus: Autocannons can be customized in a few ways, both cosmetic and functional.
Wrenching the end of an autocannon will change the type of barrel end.
Recoil Springs make the barrel push back when firing.
Wrenching the autocannon breech will add handles.
Autocannons with handles are controlled by the player instead of by kinetics.
You can place a seat on the handle breech.
Wrenching the autocannon breech again will remove handles.
Any placed seats will be returned to the player or popped off.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/fir: After loading, assembling, and aiming the cannon, big cannons are ready to fire.
Power the lit cannon face on the cannon mount to fire the mounted cannon.
To disassemble the cannon to prepare it for the next shot, unpower the hammer face.
The cannon instantly snaps back to the position it was assembled at when disassembled.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/scr: Screw Breeches are strong breech blocks that do not suffer strength penalties unlike Sliding Breeches.
Use rotational force to unlock screw breeches.
Once the screw breech is fully unlocked, use kinetic contraptions to move it out of the way for loading.
Once loading is finished, close the screw breech to close the cannon.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/sli: Sliding Breeches offer a quick way to load cannons from the breech, at the cost of cannon strength.
Use rotational force to open up sliding breeches.
Once the sliding breech is fully opened, cannon munitions can be loaded through the breech.
The sliding breech must be not obstructed by munitions or loader contraptions for it to close.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/ups: Cannon Mounts can be rotated to face downwards by clicking their sides with a wrench.
Cannon Mounts can also be placed upside-down on the bottom of blocks.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/usi: Autocannons fire at a fast rate.
They take in item munitions as input.
Spent ammunition is ejected from the breech.
Power the firing face on the Cannon Mount to make the autocannon shoot.
Increasing the power on the firing face increases the fire rate of the autocannon.
Cannon Mount Extensions provide extra interface areas for blocks.
They extend the mount they point into, as indicated by the arrow on their sides.
Fixed Cannon Mounts can be used for aiming cannons at the same spot.
They do not use kinetic input and must be manually set using the side interfaces.
Interfacing with a Fixed Cannon Mount is similar to a regular Cannon Mount, with the same control faces.
The Fixed Cannon Mount cannot be extended.
Use a wrench to rotate the Fixed Cannon Mount.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/adding: Adding tracers to big cannon projectiles
In addition to autocannon munitions, tracers can also be added to big cannon projectiles.
Unlike fuzing, tracer tips can be applied to any side of the projectile block.
Right-click the projectile with an empty hand to remove any tracers present.
As with fuzing, tracer application can be automated with Deployers.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/automa: Automating loading the Autocannon Ammo Container
Mechanical Arms can load assembled autocannons with Autocannon Ammo Containers.
Set a Cannon Mount with an autocannon as one of the Mechanical Arm's deposits.
You can dispose of empty containers by setting a deposit filter slot to an empty container.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/cannon: When loading a cannon, care must be taken to ensure that cannon loads are safe and effective.
...such as not loading enough Powder Charges...
...allowing a fired projectile to collide with another object in the barrel...
...can cause catastrophic failure and pose a major threat to the surrounding environment.
A cannon's material has two main factors that can cause the cannon to fail; its minimum projectile velocity per barrel and its strength.
The minimum projectile velocity per barrel determines how much power a projectile should have to not get stuck in a cannon.
For example, the default minimum projectile velocity of cast iron is equivalent to 1 Powder Charge for every barrel.
The barrel that the loaded projectile is in is also counted towards the barrels travelled.
The strength of a cannon determines the maximum amount of Powder Charges that can be loaded, after which the cannon has a chance to burst when firing.
For example, cast iron is strong enough to safely handle 2 Powder Charges.
The strength of a cannon can be affected by its breech.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/fillin: Autocannon Ammo Containers can be filled in-menu.
You can also configure tracer spacing in the menu.
Different ammo types have different capacities.
The container can also be filled with deployers.
Ammo with tracers will go in the tracer slot, otherwise it will go in the main slot.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/fuzing: Fuzes can be attached to certain projectiles to detonate them under certain conditions.
Right-click the projectile head with an empty hand to remove any fuzes present. Some shells are fuzed on the base instead.
Fuzing projectiles can be automated with Deployers.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/using_: Autocannon Ammo Containers are a convenient way to store autocannon ammo and to load autocannons.
Right-click a container on an Autocannon Breech to load it.
To remove a container, right-click the breech with an empty hand.
You can also swap out the container by right-clicking the breech with another container.
You can also load an assembled autocannon with a container.
However, you can only remove a present container on an assembled autocannon if it is empty, or by swapping or shift right-clicking it.
lang.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/wet_am: Protecting Munitions with Waterlogging, and its Side Effects
Propellant blocks, as well as projectiles, are vulnerable to exploding from fire and other explosions.
Munition blocks can be protected from fire and explosions by waterlogging them.
However, waterlogging causes propellant blocks to become damp.
Damp propellant is weaker and also fails to ignite if it is placed as the first propellant block in a big cannon.
To fix this, damp propellant must be left to dry, and cannot be dried in a furnace like wet sponges.
However, propellant placed in hot places like the Nether will instantly dry, similar to wet sponges.

身管套筒

为火炮构建器充能以切换抓取状态
拉取已套管的身管时，总会抓取最外一层的身管层
铸造炮胚
铸造炮胚是打造火炮的第一步
你可以通过机械自动移除使用过的铸型
像机炮这种更小的火炮则会自动去除用过的铸造砂
使用一种铸模来构建铸型（先放入铸模，再用铸造砂右键，最后右键取出铸模便可完成铸型的制作）
机械手也可以与铸模交互
用熔融金属填充铸型，以开始铸造工序
铸型会输出红石信号，这可以通过红石比较器侦测到
铸型输出的红石信号等级从0~14对应着铸型中熔融金属的注入量，15对应着炮胚已成型
当注满铸型之后，还需要一段时间冷却成型
所需的时间长短取决于铸模的大小
你可以通过破坏或交互来移除用过的铸型
使用火炮焊具
在生存模式下放置的火炮方块不会连接彼此
而火炮焊具一次可以快速的将两个火炮方块连接起来
右键两个临近的火炮方块来焊接他们
所要焊接的火炮方块必须对齐、相连、使用同样的材料并是同一类火炮
无效
默认情况下，部分材料和类型的火炮方块无法使用火炮焊具进行焊接
火炮焊具可以焊接各种类型的火炮
需要注意的是，某些类型的火炮在焊接后会变得更脆弱
因此，更推荐整体制作和移动火炮
烧结完成套管的身管
烧结套管过的身管，就可以将它们烧制成可以使用的火炮部件了
这个过程类似于批量熔炼物品，将鼓风机放置在熔岩后方来产生加热气流
一个套好管的火炮方块需要所有层皆正确才可以进行烧制
烧结至成品需要一定的时间
处理火炮部件半成品
一些钻孔后的火炮部件需要额外的物品才能完成装配工序
这大多数是炮闩的闩体
对半成品使用如下列出的物品来装配它
机械手也可以用于装配半成品
制造一个速射炮闩
使用速射构件来将楔式炮闩转化为速射炮闩
机械手也可以用于制造速射炮闩
对速射炮闩使用扳手可以将其转换回楔式炮闩
搬运火炮
默认情况下，大多数铸造好的火炮如不使用带精准采集的镐子破坏会变成废料
使用机械动力的装置可以以多种方式来移动火炮
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_kinetics/: 机械臂可用于重新装载速射炮闩
右键火炮底座可以设置机械臂的输出
只有速射炮闩关闭时，机械臂才能够操作
机械臂无法在炮闩打开时装填火炮
当为机械臂设置了存储区域时，一旦火炮发射，机械臂就将自动取出空弹壳
存放区域应配备过滤空的大型弹药的功能，以避免物品管理混乱
速射炮闩使得已加载的火炮的快速重新装载成为了可能
右键速射炮闩的末端可以打开或关闭
首先，右键速射炮闩的开口一侧来装载发射物
然后装载发射剂并关闭炮闩
建议使用大型弹药来实现更快的重新装载
然后火炮就可以开火了
剩下的弹药，如用过的大型弹药盒将被自动弹射出来
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/ba: 使用基础机械动力结构来装载火炮
动力活塞、起重机和绳索滑轮也可以用来装载火炮
根据特定方块的连接情况，弹药可以从大型火炮里拉出来
与火炮装载器不同，其他方块也可以附着在结构上
这并不会影响火炮的装载，不过只有对齐的弹药可以装入火炮中。
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/ha: 手动装载工具很方便用于装载火炮
弹药也可以直接装入已加载的火炮中
手动装载工具也能够与已加载的火炮互动
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_loader/lo: 火炮装载器与动力活塞类似，可以利用活塞杆来增长它的移动距离
火炮装载器必须配备某种头部部件，如装药机头或胶质刷头
在一般情况下，应当使用装药机头
而当火炮堵塞的时候，就需要用到胶质刷头了
在给火炮重新装载之前，需要先卸载火炮
当给火炮装载弹药时，装载弹药用的装置、弹药和火炮都必须在一条直线上
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/ass: 要加载火炮，首先要将它放在一个火炮底座上
用红石信号给火炮底座上印有 ”锤子图案“ 的面充能，火炮就能被加载
为火炮底座提供旋转力来上下瞄准
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/cus: 机炮在很多方面上可以改装，包括装饰性和功能性的
用扳手对机炮口右键，可以改变炮筒口的类型
复进弹簧可以让炮筒在开火时被推回
对机炮炮闩使用扳手可以增加一对把手
带把手的机炮会由玩家直接操控，代替机械控制
你可以在带扶手的炮闩上放置坐垫
对着机炮炮闩再次使用扳手可以移除把手
放置的坐垫会被返还给玩家或者掉落
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/fir: 当您完成了装弹、加载和瞄准之后，火炮就已准备好开火了
在火炮底座上，为火炮炮位上印有 ”引线图案” 的面施加红石信号，火炮就能够开火
而取消掉火炮底座上印有 ”锤子图案” 的面的红石信号，就能够卸载火炮
当卸载时，火炮的方块会立马恢复到原来加载之前的位置
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/scr: 镙式炮闩作为一种坚固的炮尾，不会像楔式炮闩一样在材料强度方面受到影响
使用旋转力来为镙式炮闩开锁
当镙式炮闩被彻底开锁后，可以使用动力结构将它从装弹路径上移开
装弹完成后，为镙式炮闩闭锁以封闭身管
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/sli: 楔式炮闩提供了一种更加快速便捷的后方装弹方式，而代价是降低了火炮的材料强度
用旋转力为楔式炮闩开锁
当炮闩被完全开锁后，炮弹就可以直接从后方进行装载
楔式炮闩必须不受炮弹或者火炮装载器的阻挡才能被关闭
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/usi: 机炮有着非常快的开火速率
机炮接受物品形式的弹药输入
弹壳将会从炮闩处排出
为火炮底座上印有“引线图案”的面以使机炮开火
提高“开火面”的红石充能等级，机炮的开火速率也会相应提高
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/adding: 除了自动炮弹药外，还可以将曳光装置安装到大炮炮弹上
与引信不同，曳光装置可以应用于炮弹的任何一侧
用空手右键炮弹的头部可以移除所有装备在上面的曳光
像引信一样，曳光装置也能使用机械手自动装配
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/automa: 自动化装载机炮弹药箱
动力臂可以使用机炮弹药箱来为已加载的机炮装载弹药
将机炮的火炮底座设为动力臂的目标
你可以将动力臂的一个目标的过滤器设置为空弹药箱来处理空弹药箱
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/cannon: 当给火炮装弹时，必须确保装载的弹药安全且有效
…或者让发射物与筒内的其他物体相互碰撞…
…就可能会导致毁灭性的失败，甚至对周围环境构成巨大的威胁
火炮材料有两个因素可能会导致发射失败：每炮管的最小发射速度和材料强度
每格炮管的最小发射速度决定了炮弹必须具有多少能量才能不被卡在火炮中
例如，生铁材料的默认最小发射速度等同于每格炮管对应一份发射药
装载的炮弹所在位置的炮管方块也计算在内
材料强度决定了可以装载的最大发射药量，假如超过了最大发射药量，火炮就有可能在开火的时候炸膛
例如，铸铁材料足以扛得住住两份发射药
火炮的强度也会受到其炮闩的影响
假如用危险的方法装载...
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/fillin: 机炮弹药箱可以在菜单中进行装填
你也可以在菜单中编辑曳光间隔
不同种类的弹药具有不同的能力
弹药箱也可以使用机械手进行装填
装备了曳光的弹药会放在曳光栏，否则都会放在主栏中
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/fuzing: 引信可以装备在炮弹上，使得炮弹在某些特定条件下引爆
用空手右键炮弹的头部可以移除所有装备在上面的引信
可以用机械手实现自动化装备引信
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/using_: 使用机炮弹药箱可以便捷地储存机炮弹药和装填机炮
手持机炮弹药箱对着机炮炮闩右键来装载弹药箱
空手右键机炮炮闩来移除弹药箱
手持另一个弹药箱右键机炮炮闩可以切换成新的弹药箱
使用机炮弹药箱，你也可以为已经加载的机炮装载弹药
然而，装载在已经加载的机炮上的弹药箱，则只能在弹药耗尽后才能移除，否则只能使用其他弹药箱来切换或者蹲下右键点击以移除

zh.item.createbigcannons.ap_autocannon_roun: 具有_高穿透力_，最适合_较脆弱的目标_，例如_木制的结构和较薄的墙面_。_不能装备引信或者被引爆_
zh.item.createbigcannons.block_armor_inspec: 方块穿透抗性检测工具
zh.item.createbigcannons.cannon_crafting_wa: 用于火炮加工的各个工序，如_铸造，钻孔，装配_，和_烧结_，使得工序_立即完成_
zh.item.createbigcannons.delayed_impact_fuz: 打开 _配置延时碰炸引信_ 菜单，用于设置引信的延时时间
引信会在发射物发生碰撞后的所设定时间后引爆

这个引信在损坏前可穿透 _%s_ 个方块

zh.item.createbigcannons.flak_autocannon_ro: 在炮弹的方向上释放_弹片_，弹片会_扩散很大一片区域_
可以用来攻击_空中目标_，用_弹片_压制目标
zh.item.createbigcannons.gas_mask.tooltip.s: _佩戴在头部_以免受气云影响，但对_滞留型药水_、_龙息_和_药水液珠_无效
zh.item.createbigcannons.impact_fuze.toolti: 引信_可能_会受_发射物的触碰_而引爆

这个引信在损坏前可穿透 _%s_ 个方块
当_受到撞击_后，在一个_短暂的时间_后引爆。由于_简单的触发机械结构_，当受到碰撞后并不会百分百的触发记时。只能装配在炮弹_前端_。无法作为_基础引信_
_更廉价的_机炮弹药，对_实体_更有效
zh.item.createbigcannons.partial_bronze_aut: 青铜机炮炮闩抽筒子（半成品）
zh.item.createbigcannons.partial_cast_iron_: 铸铁机炮炮闩抽筒子（半成品）
zh.item.createbigcannons.partial_steel_auto: 钢制机炮炮闩抽筒子（半成品）
zh.item.createbigcannons.proximity_fuze.too: 打开 _设置近炸引信_ 菜单，在菜单中可以设置引信引爆的距离
当炮弹与其他方块的距离进入了设定范围时，引信引爆
当靠近某个方块时引爆。只能装配在炮弹_前端_。无法作为_基础引信_
zh.item.createbigcannons.ram_rod.tooltip.ac: 将弹药方块推进火炮更深处，同时如果可以也能将火炮方块推出来
推动弹药方块。在推动的时候，一连串的弹药方块_必须要和一个有效的火炮方块连在一起_
zh.item.createbigcannons.ram_rod.tooltip.re: 最远推入火炮内 _%s 个方块_ 的距离
zh.item.createbigcannons.ram_rod.tooltip.su: 用于_手动装载火炮_，免于使用火炮装载器装置。_消耗饱和度和饥饿值_，且随着推动的过程中逐格消耗
zh.item.createbigcannons.timed_fuze.tooltip: 打开 _配置定时引信_ 菜单，用于设置引信的延时时间
引信会在炮弹被激活之后的所设定的延时时间后引爆
引爆时间：_%s 秒 %s 刻_
引爆时间：%s 秒 %s 刻
从发射起在 _设定的时间_ 后引爆
zh.item.createbigcannons.tracer_tip.tooltip: 让机炮炮弹发光，使弹道轨迹可见
zh.item.createbigcannons.worm.tooltip.actio: 将弹药方块从火炮尾方向拉出来，且一次只能拉一个方块
zh.item.createbigcannons.worm.tooltip.reach: 最远刷入火炮内 _%s 个方块_ 的距离
zh.item.createbigcannons.worm.tooltip.summa: 用于_手动拉出火炮中的弹药方块_，免于使用火炮装载器装置。_消耗饱和度和饥饿值_
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/ups: 使用扳手右击火炮底座侧面，可将其旋转至面朝下方。
火炮底座也可以倒置安装在方块底部。
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.cannon_mount/usi: 火炮底座延长器为火炮底座提供了额外的动力接口。
它们会连接其侧面箭头指向的方向上的火炮底座。
固定式火炮底座可用于将火炮瞄准同一位置。
它们不接入动力，必须通过侧面的面板调节角度。
与固定式火炮底座交互和与普通火炮底座交互的方式相同，也使用相同的控制面。
固定式火炮底座不能使用火炮底座延长器。
使用扳手可以旋转固定式火炮底座。
zh.createbigcannons.ponder.munitions/wet_am: 浸水保护弹药及其副作用
发射药和炮弹都很脆弱，遇到火焰或其他爆炸时会殉爆。
将弹药浸水，可以让弹药块免受火焰和爆炸的伤害。
但是，浸水会使弹药变得潮湿。
受潮的发射药威力减弱，而且如果放在大炮的第一节发射药位置，将无法点燃。
要解决这个问题，必须让受潮的发射药自然晾干，不能像湿海绵那样用熔炉烘干。
不过，把发射药放在下界这样的炎热环境中，它们就会像湿海绵一样迅速烘干。
zh.item.createbigcannons.block_armor_inspec: 方块穿透抗性检测工具
展示方块抵御 _炮弹撞击_ 的 _材质属性_。 展示方块的 _韧性_ (阻止穿透) 和 _硬度_ (抵抗表面损伤)。
zh.item.createbigcannons.delayed_inertia_fu: 打开 _配置延时惯性引信_ 菜单，用于设置引信的延时时间。
在发射物发生碰撞后，引信会在设定时间后引爆。
当发生碰撞时这个引信会有 _%s%%_ 的概率开始倒计时。
这个引信在损坏前可穿透 _%s_ 个方块。
引信在炮弹 _受到撞击_ 后经过 _短暂延时_ 后引爆。 相比普通延时碰炸引信，这款引信 _更加精密_ ，引爆更稳定。 也可以作为 _弹底引信_ 。
zh.item.createbigcannons.inertia_fuze.toolt: 引信 _可能_ 会受 _发射物的触碰_ 而引爆。
当发生碰撞时这个引信会有 _%s%%_ 的概率引爆。
这个引信在损坏前可穿透 _%s_ 个方块。
引信在炮弹 _受到撞击_ 时引爆。 相比普通碰炸引信，这款引信 _更加精密_ ，在 _跳弹和反弹_ 时引爆更稳定。 也可以作为 _弹底引信_ 。
zh.item.createbigcannons.wired_fuze.tooltip: 引信在接收到红石信号时引爆。
当装有引信的炮弹 _被红石激活时_ 引爆。 可用于制作 _简易爆炸装置_。 _不会在火炮发射时爆炸_。
