lang.create_abyss.command.queue_submarine_lia: Queued spawning of %s submarine lianas of length %s, starting from your position
lang.create_abyss.command.spawn_liana_success: Successfully spawned a submarine liana of length %s
lang.create_submarine.configuration.ballastFo: Multiplier on the vertical force ballast tanks apply. Lower = slower dive/ascend, higher = snappier.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.ballastLi:
Submarine mass each ballast tank can drive up or down (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of tanks: a heavy submarine needs more of them.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.ballastTr: Multiplier on the ballast vent fill/drain transfer rate. Lower = slower filling/emptying, higher = faster.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.ballastVe: Maximum vertical speed (blocks per tick) ballast tanks drive the submarine at when diving or ascending. Higher = faster. The old fixed value was 2.0.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.client.to: Client-side settings for UI and rendering.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.deeperOce: How many blocks deeper to push the ocean floor when Deeper Oceans is on. WARNING: large values generate and render far more terrain and can badly hurt performance. Raise it carefully. Default 10.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.floaterLi:
Mass each floater can push toward the surface (roughly 1 per block).
Total lift scales with the number of floaters.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.disableIm: Disable all hull implosion damage from water pressure.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.disableSt: Disable all Deep Seas startup UI screens (Welcome screen and Update notifications). Highly recommended to set this to TRUE if you are creating a modpack.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.enableDee: Deepen the ocean floor below vanilla. Off = vanilla ocean depth. Set the amount with Deeper Oceans Depth.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.enableBoa: Hide the ocean surface seen inside floating boats (sub-levels without an oxygen system).
lang.create_submarine.configuration.globalMax: Cap applied to maxWaterDepth of all non Create Deep Seas blocks. Per-block values are stored in config/submarine_hull.json.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.ignoredUp: Internal: stores the version string of the last update notification dismissed by the user.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.implosion: Multiplier on every block's implosion chance at runtime. Lower = slower cracking, higher = faster cracking.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.maxDepthM: Multiplier on every block's effective maxWaterDepth at runtime. Lower = more fragile hulls, higher = tougher hulls.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.oxygenMax: Maximum size, in blocks, of a creation that oxygen diffusers can scan and fill with breathable air. Raise this if air pockets stop working on very large ships. WARNING: large values use more memory and take longer to scan.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.pulleyMax: Maximum sliding speed of a pulley along a steel cable (blocks/s). Above this speed the pulley starts overheating.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.steelCabl: Maximum length of a steel cable in blocks (distance between its two attachment points). Very long cables can cause server lag. Default 1000.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.title: Create Deep Seas
lang.create_submarine.configuration.waterThru: Multiplier on water thruster thrust output. Lower = weaker propulsion, higher = stronger.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.welcomeSc: Internal: Set to true once the Deep Seas welcome screen is confirmed. Set back to false to show the welcome screen again on the next main menu.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.ballast_vent.tex: The vent requires rotational force to operate.
It must be connected to the ballasts via pipes.
Once powered and connected, it manages ballast pressure.
The vent MUST have at least one face in contact with the sea.
Reverse the direction of rotation to switch the pump to Drain Mode and expel water outside!
lang.create_submarine.ponder.electrolyzer.tex: The Electrolyzer requires water to produce oxygen.
It must be powered by Forge Energy (FE).
Water is converted into Oxygen for your submarine!
You have the choice between Create Crafts & Additions, Create New Age, and Create Power Grid to provide electricity.
The Oxygen Diffuser requires oxygen generated by an Electrolyzer.
It consumes oxygen proportionally to the size of the submarine.
To activate the Oxygen Diffuser, provide it with a redstone signal.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_1:
Pinch the cable between
two Pulleys facing each other
to attach a sublevel to it.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_2:
The sublevel will then
follow the cable wherever it goes.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.head: Steel Cable
lang.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.text:
Entities can walk on
a taut steel cable.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable_elec:
With an electricity mod such as
Create: Addition, supply FE
directly to the Rope Winch
holding the cable to electrify it.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_1: The Barometer indicates the pressure applied on the submarine.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_2: It compares it to the maximum pressure the hull can sustain based on its weakest block.
lang.create_submarine.ponder.barometer.text_3: You can also name the fish inside with a Name Tag to have a companion in the abyss!
lang.create_submarine.ponder.barometer_displa: You can attach a Display Link to the Barometer.
This allows you to broadcast the submarine's depth and hull integrity to any Display Board!
lang.create_submarine.ponder.water_thruster.t: The Water Thruster uses pressurized water to generate thrust.
Connecting it to a water source and providing kinetic energy will activate it.
The more pressure and speed, the faster you go!
This tank provides the necessary water for the propulsion.
lang.create_submarine.ui.text.select_block_ti: Select a block to edit its properties
lang.create_submarine.update.message: A new version of Create Deep Seas is available: v%s! Download it on %s.
lang.create_submarine.update.message_screen: A new version of Create Deep Seas is available: v%s
lang.create_submarine.update.title: Deep Seas Update
lang.create_submarine.welcome.message: It's strongly recommended to set up your Deep Seas preferences before you dive in — hull strength, propulsion, ocean depth and more can all be tuned to your liking.
lang.create_submarine.welcome.title: Welcome to Create Deep Seas
lang.item.create_submarine.ballast_tank.toolt:
Capacity can be seen with
Create's engineer goggles.

Allows a submarine to float,
it can be filled with water with a
lang.item.create_submarine.creative_oxygenato:
Automatically manages oxygen
and water drainage.

Removes water when
the submarine is airtight.
lang.item.create_submarine.floater.tooltip.su:
Allows a boat to float
on the water surface.
lang.item.create_submarine.pressurizer.toolti:
Allows submarines to have
pressure-resistant windows.
lang.item.create_submarine.underwater_mine.to:
When attached to a Create Aeronautics contraption,
this mine will detonate if entities or
boats get too close.
lang.create_submarine.configuration.submarine:
Multiplier on Submarine Propeller thrust and airflow output.
Lower = weaker propulsion, higher = stronger.
lang.item.create_submarine.submarine_propelle: Excellent in water, but useless outside
lang.create_submarine.lithostitched_missing.m:
An experimental feature has been enabled in the Create Deep Seas configuration, however this requires the 'Lithostitched' library to function properly.

The game will not crash, but the option has been automatically disabled. You will need to re-enable it in the configuration once Lithostitched is installed.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.not_in: You must be inside or on a submarine.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.world_: The submarine world is not loaded.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.failed: Failed to compute player's local position.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.must_b: You must be inside the submarine area.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.too_la: The submarine area is too large to scan.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.sealed: The submarine is perfectly sealed! No holes detected.
lang.create_submarine.command.findhole.outsid: Could not find a valid enclosure. You are outside the submarine.

zh.item.create_submarine.creative_oxygenato:
当潜艇气密时
移除舱内积水。

自动管理氧气
和排水。
zh.item.create_submarine.ballast_tank.toolt:
使潜艇能够浮起，
可通过

佩戴工程师护目镜时
可以查看容量。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.ballast_vent.tex: 排口需要旋转力才能工作。
它必须通过管道连接到压载水罐。
接入动力并连接完成后，它会管理压载压力。
排口必须至少有一个面接触海水。
反转旋转方向可切换为排水模式，将水排出！
氧气扩散器需要由电解器生成的氧气。
它会根据潜艇大小按比例消耗氧气。
提供红石信号以激活氧气扩散器。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.electrolyzer.tex: 电解器需要水来生产氧气。
它需要 Forge 能量（FE）供能。
水会被转化为氧气，并输送到你的潜艇中！
你可以选用 Create Crafts & Additions、Create New Age 或 Create Power Grid 来提供电力。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.water_thruster.t: 喷水推进器使用加压水流产生推进力。
将它连接到水源并提供动能即可激活。
压力越高、转速越快，推进速度就越快！
这个水罐会为推进提供所需的水。
zh.item.create_submarine.pressurizer.toolti:
使潜艇拥有
能够抵抗水压的舷窗。
zh.item.create_submarine.floater.tooltip.su:
使船只能够浮在
水面。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_1:
用缆绳点击面对面的两个滑轮
以连接到模拟装置。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.pulley.text_2:
此模拟装置随后将
跟随缆绳移动。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.head: 钢制缆绳
zh.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable.text: 实体可在绷紧的钢制缆绳上移动。
zh.create_submarine.ponder.steel_cable_elec:
使用诸如
Create Crafts & Additions 的电力模组，
直接向持有缆绳的
绳索绞盘提供 FE 以使其通电。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.title: 机械动力：深海
zh.create_submarine.configuration.propulsio: 推进器以及压载的调节。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.disableIm: 关闭所有由水压导致的船体内爆伤害。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.globalMax: 应用于所有非“机械动力：深海”方块的 maxWaterDepth 上限。各方块数值储存在 config/submarine_hull.json 中。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.maxDepthM: 运行时对所有方块的有效 maxWaterDepth 的倍率。数值越低，船体越脆弱；数值越高，船体越坚固。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.implosion: 运行时对所有方块的内爆几率的倍率。数值越低，船体开裂速度越慢；数值越高，船体开裂速度越快。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.ballastFo: 运行时对压载水罐施加垂直推力的倍率。数值越低，下潜和上浮速度越慢；数值越高，响应越灵敏。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.ballastTr: 对压载排口注水/排水传输速率的倍率。数值越低，注水和排水速度越慢；数值越高，注水和排水速度越快。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.waterThru: 对喷水推进器推进力输出的倍率。数值越低，推进力越弱；数值越高，推进力越强。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.pulleyMax: 钢制缆绳上滑轮的最大滑动速度（格/秒）。超过此速度后，滑轮将开始过热。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.experimen: 实验性内容，可能无法正常工作。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.enablePer: 启用对潜艇和船只生效的实验性永久水体剔除测试。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.enableDee: 使原版海床更深。关闭时为原版海洋深度。可在“更深的海洋深度”中调节深度。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.deeperOce: 决定当“更深的海洋”开启时，新的海床比原版深多少方块。警告：较大的值将会导致更多地形生成并渲染，可能严重影响性能。请小心设定。默认值为 10。
zh.create_submarine.welcome.title: 欢迎来到机械动力：深海
zh.create_submarine.welcome.message: 强烈建议您在下潜之前调整深海偏好设定——船体强度、推进力、海洋深度以及更多内容都可以根据您的喜好调整。
zh.create_submarine.command.no_sublevel_con: 未在当前维度找到子层级容器。

zh.create_submarine.configuration.disableSt: 禁用本模组的所有启动界面。强烈建议您在创建整合包时启用。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.ignoredUp: 内部设置：记录用户最近一次忽略的更新通知版本号。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.mechanics: 推进器，压载以及缆绳的调节。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.steelCabl: 钢制缆绳的最大长度（两端连接点之间的方块距离）。过长的缆绳可能造成服务器卡顿。默认值为 1000。
zh.create_submarine.configuration.welcomeSc: 内部设置：在确认机械动力：深海欢迎界面后自动设为是。将其改回否可在下次进入主菜单时再次显示欢迎界面。
zh.create_submarine.ui.text.select_block_ti: 选择一个方块以编辑其属性
zh.create_submarine.update.message: 机械动力：深海的新版本可用：v%1$s！可前往 %2$s 下载。
zh.create_submarine.update.message_screen: 机械动力：深海新版本可用：v%s

lang.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.global_setti: Combine individual train stations into a single multi-platform station with its own name so that the navigator can suggest transfers and more.
Exclude Train Stations which should not appear in the navigation results. These stations will be ignored when generating routes.
Create train categories to organize all trains (e.g. regional services, long-distance services, ...). Users can decide which train categories they want to use.

lang.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.search_setti: The minimum time that should be available to change train. (1h ~ 50 Real Life Seconds)
Decide which trains from which train categories you want to use.
lang.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.advanced_dis: Determines how detailed the information is.

If activated, the arrival of a train that changes the Schedule Section here, is displayed. If the train then continues into a non-navigable section or the option 'Include start of next section' is deactivated, this option is ignored.

If activated, the text 'Do not board' is displayed if the trains changes the schedule section. If the train then continues into a non-navigable section or the option 'Include start of next section' is deactivated, this option is ignored.
The number that is added to the current carriage index. (e.g. Index = 3, Offset = 5, Result = 08)
If checked, the value will not be added to the carriage index, but replaced by the entered value. (e.g. Index = 3, Offset = 5, Result = 05)
Highlights the train name text with the color of the current train line.

If a train stops multiple times at a station (e.g. once in one direction and then in the other), all arrivals are shown on the displays. If this setting is turned off, only the next arrival of a train is shown, or nothing at all, depending on the display configuration.
in percent of the remaining screen width

Whether the entire area of the text field should be filled or only the text.
Whether the scale and position should be updated by an attached display link.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_text_: Text components which should be displayed on the passenger displays.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.display_inf: Determines how much information should be displayed on your display board.
The display will only show the most important information without additional details.
The most important information with some details will be shown, such as train speed, stopovers, etc.
Shows all information that could be interesting and displays it in a fancy layout. Not recommended for small displays as the text might become very small.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.display_typ: The type of your display which depends on their purpose.
Intended to be used outside of trains as it shows information about the train itself such as the name, destination and (if selected) stopovers and other information.
Represents the displays found inside of trains. These displays will show the next stop, the exit direction and (if selected) train speed and a route overview.
These displays should be used on train station platforms and shows the next arriving trains with additional details if selected. Cannot be used in trains!
A summary of all trains departing from a station.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.side.descri: The side of the block where the information should be rendered on.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.side.info.f: The information will only be rendered on the front side. This is the default behaviour.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.side.info.b: The information will be rendered on both sides.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.time_displa: Determines how the time should be displayed.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_filte: Compares trains based on the selected criterion to decide which trains should be taken into account.
Every train is taken into account here.
Only trains with the same train line are taken into account.
Only trains with the same train category are taken into account.
Only trains with the same name are taken into account.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.time_source: The source from which the time should be calculated.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.text_scale_: The behavior of the text when the length exceeds the available space.
lang.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_stop_: Shows the arrivals and departures of each train.
Shows only the arrivals of each train. If the train leaves an unnavigable section, nothing will be displayed.
Shows only train arrivals, unless the train starts a new section at this station. In that case, the departure is shown as well.
Shows only the departures of each train. If the train then enters an unnavigable section, nothing will be displayed.
Shows only train departures, unless the train terminates at this station. In that case, the arrival is shown as well.
lang.createrailwaysnavigator.schedule.conditi: This filter text is used to determine which stations should be used for train separation. If left empty, the filter from the instruction is used.
lang.createrailwaysnavigator.schedule.instruc: Beginning of a new schedule section.
Drag this entry to change the order
Elements higher up have a higher priority and are selected first.
Select the station with the fewest signals turned red by Redstone.
Selects the station with the fewest trains on the route.
lang.goggles.createrailwaysnavigator.train_li: Press SHIFT to show as In-Game time
lang.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.route_overvi: The schedule of your saved route has changed. Please check the navigator for these changes.

zh.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.advanced_dis: 若启用，将会显示以该站为时刻表区段开头的列车的到达终点信息。若新区段不可导航或旧区段未启用'包含下一区段首站'选项，则该选项会被忽略。
若启用，列车切换区段时会显示'切勿上车'的文本。若新区段不可导航或旧区段未启用'包含下一区段首站'选项，则该选项会被忽略。
加到当前车厢序号上的值。（例：序号=3，偏移=5，则结果=08）
若勾选，数值不再加到序号上，而是直接作为序号。设为输入的数值，而非加上当前的车厢号码。（例：序号=3，偏移=5，则结果=05）
使用列车线路的颜色作为列车名称文本的底色。
当一列车多次停靠同一站点（例如上行停靠后下行停靠），每次停靠均在显示器显示。当此选项关闭时，取决于显示器配置，将显示下一站或不显示任何内容。

zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_text_: 乘客显示器上应显示的文本内容。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.display_inf: 决定显示器上应显示多少信息。
只展示最重要的部分，不显示其它细节。
将展示最重要的信息，以及一些细节，例如列车速度、经停站等。
以美观的布局显示所有可能有用的信息。不建议在小型显示器上使用，因为文本可能会变得非常小。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.display_typ: 决定显示器的类型，由其用途决定。
用于列车外部，展示列车自身信息，例如名称、终点站，以及（若选定）经停站与其他信息。
代表适用于列车内部的显示器。这种显示器将显示下一站、开门方向以及（如果选择）列车速度和路线概览。
这种显示器应当在火车站的站台使用，显示下一进站列车，若选定还可附加其他细节。不可在列车内使用！
显示车站全部出发列车的总览。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.side.descri: 决定信息应显示在方块的哪一面。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.side.info.f: 信息仅在正面显示，这是默认选项。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.time_displa: ETA（预计到达时间、estimated time of arrival）
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_filte: 基于所选标准对列车进行比较，决定应包含哪些列车。
只包含线路相同的列车。
只包含类别相同的列车。
只包含名称相同的列车。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.time_source: 计算时间时采用的数据来源。
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.text_scale_: 文本长度超出可用空间后的行为，
zh.enum.createrailwaysnavigator.train_stop_: 显示每辆经过列车的发出和到达站。
仅显示每辆经过列车将到达的站点，若列车恰离开不可导航区段，则不显示该列车信息。
显示列车到达情况，但当此站是列车本区间的起点站，显示该列车的出发情况。
仅显示每辆经过列车将到达的站点，若列车即将进入不可导航区段，则不显示该列车信息。
显示列车发出情况，但当此站是列车本区间的终点站，显示该列车的到达情况。
zh.createrailwaysnavigator.schedule.conditi: 在该种列车发车后%s（%s）发车：
此过滤器的内容将用于确定执行列车分离的站点。若留空，则使用与列车动作指令相同的过滤器。
zh.createrailwaysnavigator.schedule.instruc: 带优先级目的地指令设置
越靠上的元素优先级越高，会首先选中。
选择沿途被红石切换为红灯的信号机较少的车站。
选择沿途列车最少的车站。

zh.gui.createrailwaysnavigator.global_setti: 创建列车线路以将不同列车分组，覆盖其显示名称，以及调整各线路的其他设置。（仅能通过时刻表分配给列车）

lang.railways.ponder.conductor_constructing.t: Conductors are constructed with an andesite casing.
lang.railways.ponder.conductor_redstoning.tex: Conductors can press buttons when a player looks at them.
Conductors also toggle levers when a player looks at them.
Conductors do not activate redstone if a player is wearing a different-colored cap from them.
lang.railways.ponder.conductor_toolboxing.tex: Toolboxes function normally when equipped on Conductors.
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_1: Doors have multiple modes of operation: Normal, Manual, and Special
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_2: In normal mode (the default) and manual mode, manual operation of the door is possible
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_3: and redstone operation works in normal mode and special mode
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_4: Doors in normal and special modes open and close when a contraption moves or stops
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_5: Doors in manual mode only change when a player interacts with them
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_6: Doors in special mode cannot be toggled simply by using them
lang.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_7: Sneaking, however, allows the player to toggle the door anyway
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_1: Select a Train Track then place the Coupler nearby
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_2: The Train Coupler lets you couple and decouple trains without disassembling them
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_3: By scrolling with a wrench you can change the gap between the couple/decouple pads
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_4: By using a wrench you can cycle between coupling, decoupling, and both modes
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_5: Stations can be used to help align trains for coupling
lang.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_6: By powering a coupler you can couple/decouple a properly aligned train
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_1: Semaphores are placed on poles above Train Signals
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_2: Semaphore poles can be made of different materials
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_3: Semaphores show the current state of the signal below the pole
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_4: If a brass signal has multiple valid exit paths...
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_5: ... a second semaphore can be placed above the first
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_6: The bottom semaphore will now close if any of the available paths are blocked
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_7: The top semaphore will close if all paths are blocked
lang.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_8: When 2 semaphores are placed on a non-brass signal, they both close simultaneously
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_1: Select a Train Track then place the Switch nearby
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_2: The Switch will direct any Trains passing over the marker
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_3: Cycle the switch to the right by using it
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_4: Cycle the switch to the left by using it while sneaking
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_5: Switches provide a comparator signal based on the direction: 1 for left, 0 for straight, and 2 for right
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_6: Switch direction can also be set by a redstone signal, and can be locked by powering the bottom
lang.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_7: Projectiles also cycle switches on impact
lang.railways.remote_lens.tool.bound_usage: Use to spy through the eyes of the bound conductor!
lang.railways.remote_lens.tool.not_bound: Not bound, use on a conductor wearing goggles to bind.
lang.railways.station.train_limit.tooltip.1: Reserve station before approaching train has arrived
lang.railways.station.train_limit.tooltip.2: to more evenly space trains in a multi-platform station
lang.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.carriage_: Carriage(s) not aligned properly. Hint: The center of the bogey should be aligned over the coupler track point.
Carriages must be facing the same direction. Hint: Use a wrench to reorient the carriages.
lang.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.missing_t: Requires both track points to be occupied
lang.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.mode_not_: Action not permitted in current mode
lang.railways.whistle.failure.conductor_missi: Conductor not found or it was not riding the bound train.
lang.railways.whistle.failure.not_owner: You must be the owner of the train to cancel its schedule.
lang.railways.whistle.not_owner: You must be the owner of the train to bind the whistle.
lang.railways.whistle.tool.bound_auto_clear: Or on air to dismiss the auto schedule of the bound train
lang.railways.whistle.tool.bound_auto_usage: Deployers can use whistles on stations to summon trains
lang.railways.whistle.tool.bound_usage: Use on a track or station to summon the bound train!
lang.railways.whistle.tool.not_bound: Not bound, use on a conductor riding a train to bind.

zh.railways.ponder.conductor_constructing.t: 指挥机器人由安山机壳组成
zh.railways.ponder.conductor_redstoning.hea: 借助指挥机器人远程操控红石元件
zh.railways.ponder.conductor_redstoning.tex: 指挥机器人会在被玩家注视时按下附近的按钮
它同样会在被玩家注视时拉动它附近的拉杆
当玩家戴着与其颜色不一致的列车长帽时，指挥机器人不会与红石元件交互
zh.railways.ponder.conductor_toolboxing.hea: 使用指挥机器人运输工具箱
zh.railways.ponder.conductor_toolboxing.tex: 装备在指挥机器人身上时，工具箱可以正常使用
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_1: 结构门有多种可选的操作模式：兼容、手动和自动
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_2: 可以右击交互开关处于兼容（默认项）和手动模式下的门
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_3: 另外，可以使用红石开关处于兼容和自动模式下的门
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_4: 处于兼容与自动模式下的门，会在移动装置运动时关闭，停止时打开
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_5: 手动模式下的门仅能通过右击交互来开关
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_6: 对于自动模式下的门，则不能单纯地通过右击交互开关
zh.railways.ponder.door_modes.text_7: 不过在潜行状态下，所有组装后的结构门都能通过右击交互来开关
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_1: 选择一个列车轨道，然后将连挂器放置在附近
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_2: 连挂器可以让你在不拆解列车的情况下连接或分离列车
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_3: 可以手执扳手并滑动鼠标滚轮，来调整两个标记间的距离
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_4: 可以用扳手，在连挂、摘车和智能三种模式间切换
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_5: 连挂列车时可以使用列车站点辅助以对齐列车
zh.railways.ponder.train_coupler.text_6: 连挂器会在被红石充能时，连接或分离已对齐的列车
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.header: 使用臂板信号机可视化信号状态
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_1: 将臂板信号机放置在列车信号机上方的柱上
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_2: 信号柱可以由不同的材料组成
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_3: 臂板信号机会实时显示柱下信号机的信号状态
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_4: 如果黄铜信号机控制的信号区间存在多个有效的出口……
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_5: ……可以在上方放置第二个臂板信号机
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_6: 如果信号区间有任意出口被占用，底部的信号机将会关闭
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_7: 如果信号区间的所有出口都被占用，顶部的信号机将会关闭
zh.railways.ponder.train_semaphore.text_8: 当两个臂板信号机都处在非黄铜信号区间内时，它们会在区间被占用时同时关闭
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_1: 选择一个列车轨道，然后将转辙器放置在附近
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_2: 转辙器会迫使每一个经过道岔的列车驶向其设定的方向
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_3: 右击转辙器时，会向右切换
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_4: 潜行状态下右击转辙器时，会向左切换
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_5: 可以用红石比较器输出转辙器设定的方向：1 表示左转，0 表示直行，2 表示右转
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_6: 也可以输入红石信号来切换方向，另外，转辙器会在底部被充能时锁定
zh.railways.ponder.train_switch.text_7: 转辙器会在被弹射物命中时循环切换方向
zh.railways.remote_lens.tool.bound_usage: 透过绑定的指挥机器人的双眼观察世界
zh.railways.remote_lens.tool.not_bound: 未绑定，对一个头戴工程师护目镜的指挥机器人使用以绑定
zh.railways.station.train_limit.tooltip.1: 为即将到站停靠的列车预留空位，
zh.railways.station.train_limit.tooltip.2: 使列车更均匀地停靠在多个站台
zh.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.carriage_: 车厢尚未对齐，转向架的中心应对准轨道连挂点
所有车厢都需要朝向同一方向。提示：用扳手重新安置列车
zh.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.missing_t: 两车的转向架需要分别对齐两个标记
zh.railways.tooltip.coupler.error.mode_not_: 当前状态下无法进行操作
zh.railways.whistle.failure.conductor_missi: 未找到指挥机器人，或者它未在驾驶绑定的列车
zh.railways.whistle.failure.not_owner: 只有你是列车的所有者时，才能移除它的时刻表
zh.railways.whistle.not_owner: 只有你是列车的所有者时，才能将它绑定至指挥哨
zh.railways.whistle.tool.bound_auto_clear: 或对空气使用后忽略列车的自动时刻表
zh.railways.whistle.tool.bound_auto_usage: 机械手对列车站点使用指挥哨可以呼叫对应列车
zh.railways.whistle.tool.bound_usage: 对着轨道使用，绑定的列车将驶向该轨道
zh.railways.whistle.tool.not_bound: 未绑定，对一个驾驶列车的指挥机器人使用以绑定

lang.advancement.escalated.escalator_100.desc: Ascend 100 blocks only on moving escalators
lang.advancement.escalated.escalator_100_neth: Ascend 100 blocks only on moving escalators in the nether
lang.advancement.escalated.handrail.desc: Decorate your escalator with a Mechanical Belt
lang.advancement.escalated.walkway.desc: Connect two Shafts with a walkway/escalator
lang.escalated.ponder.tag.walkways.descriptio: How to build walkways and escalators to move around efficiently
lang.escalated.ponder.walkways/adding_shafts_: Adding more Shafts to Walkways and Escalators
Additional shafts can be added to walkways for more power supply.
To add a shaft, Right-Click a middle walkway block with a Shaft item.
Once added, the walkway block side can be wrenched to block off rotational input from that side.
This also applies to walkway terminals.
To remove the shaft, wrench the block while Sneaking.
Shafts cannot be applied to escalators.
lang.escalated.ponder.walkways/creating_walkw: Right-Click two shafts with a walkway steps item to create a walkway.
Accidental selections can be cancelled with Right-Click while Sneaking.
Due to the escalator structure, the shafts are not aligned on a perfect diagonal.
The horizontal distance between the shafts is 3 blocks greater than the vertical distance.
lang.escalated.ponder.walkways/customizing_wa: Customizing Walkways and Escalators with Dyes and Handrails
Walkway and escalator steps can be dyed by Right-Clicking them with a dye item.
To remove the dye, Right-Click the walkway with a water item.
Handrails can be added to the walkway by Right-Clicking the walkway with a belt item.
This will only work if there is space above the walkway.
The handrails can also be dyed and cleaned just like the walkway.
Finally, the handrails can also be made into glass by Right-Clicking them with a glass block.
lang.escalated.ponder.walkways/widening_walkw: Walkways can be widened by connecting a walkway with an adjacent shaft.
The widening also widens handrails on top.
However, if the handrail is obstructed by something, the handrail will break.

zh.advancement.escalated.escalator_100.desc: 仅使用自动扶梯上升100格
zh.advancement.escalated.escalator_100_neth: 在下界使用自动扶梯上升100格
zh.advancement.escalated.handrail.desc: 用一条传送带装饰你的扶梯
zh.advancement.escalated.root: 欢迎来到机械动力：自动扶梯
zh.advancement.escalated.walkway.desc: 使用自动人行道/自动扶梯连接两条传动杆
zh.escalated.ponder.tag.walkways: 自动人行道与自动扶梯
zh.escalated.ponder.tag.walkways.descriptio: 如何建造自动人行道和自动扶梯来让你移动得更快
zh.escalated.ponder.walkways/adding_shafts_: 为自动人行道和自动扶梯增加更多传动杆
可以为了更多应力供应把额外的传动杆安装到梯级上
用传动杆物品右键中间的梯级方块
添加后, 这个梯级方块一侧的应力输入就可以被扳手关闭
潜行并使用扳手以取消传动杆
传动杆不能应用于自动扶梯
zh.escalated.ponder.walkways/creating_walkw: 创建自动人行道和自动扶梯
使用梯级方块右键两个传动杆以创建一条自动人行道
潜行并右键可以取消选择
创建一个自动扶梯的方法差不多
受限于扶梯的结构, 传动杆之间并不是完美的对角线
传动杆之间的横向距离需要比垂直距离多3格
zh.escalated.ponder.walkways/customizing_wa: 用染料和扶手来自定义你的自动人行道和自动扶梯
梯级和盖板可以通过手持染料右键来染色
用带水的物品右键以清除染色
可以通过手持传动带右键梯级来添加扶手
这只有在梯级上方留有空间时生效
扶手也能用类似的方法染色和清除染色
最后, 扶手可以通过手持玻璃右键来变成玻璃扶手
zh.escalated.ponder.walkways/widening_walkw: 拓宽自动人行道和自动扶梯
要想拓宽梯级，你可以将一个梯级与附近的传动杆连接。
拓宽梯级的同时也会拓宽扶手。
在任何情况下，扶手被遮挡时都会损坏。

lang.hypertube.travel.too_short: Your tube is too short to travel
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.head: Creating a Hypertube
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.text: To create a Hypertube connection, Just Right Click the tube while holding another tube.
And you have a Hypertube connection!
You can connect already placed tubes.
You can change tube segment count with the wrench.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_1: Hypertube Entrances connect to the Hypertube network, allowing high-speed travel.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_2: To be able to enter the Hypertube, you need to power with at least 16 RPM.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_3: The faster it spins, the faster you can travel.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_4: You can change the entrance mode by Right Clicking it with a Wrench.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.head: Hypertube Accelerators
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.text: Hypertube Accelerators increase the speed of entities traveling the Hypertube.
You can change to BRAKE mode by Right Clicking the Accelerator.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_1: The Hypertube Splitter can link up to three tubes, branching a line into multiple paths.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_2: While traveling, you can pick where to go with your movement keys.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_3: Right Click it with a Wrench to cycle through the Splitter modes.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_4: On Continue mode, travelers always keep going through the side tubes.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_5: On Center mode, travelers are always routed through the front tube.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.splitter.text_6: A Redstone Detector Attachment can toggle between both forced modes.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.head: Hypertube Attachments
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.text: The Scanner Attachment allows you to detect entities traveling the Hypertube. (8 power for babies and 15 for adults)
You can also place attachments in accelerators, in any side at the same time.
The Redstone Detector Attachment allows you to change the Accelerator/Entrance mode with a Redstone signal.
lang.create_hypertube.ponder.tag.hypertube_sy: Blocks and items used in Hypertube transportation systems.

zh.create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.head: 创建一个超级管道
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.simple_tube.text: 想要连接超级管道，只需手中拿着管道、鼠标右击想要连接的两段管道即可。
如此便得到了一个超级管道系统！
你也可以连接已经放置下来的管道。
你可以用扳手修改管道段的数量。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_1: 超级管道入口与整个超级管道网络相连，可以让你在管道中高速穿梭。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_2: 要想进入超级管道，你需要至少为其提供 16 RPM 的动力。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_3: 提供的转速越高，你穿梭的速度越快。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.entrance.text_4: 你可以手持扳手右击超级管道入口，以切换其模式。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.head: 超级管道加速器
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.accelerator.text: 对于在管道中穿梭的实体，超级管道加速器可以提升其速度。
你也可以右击超级管道加速器，以切换为刹车模式。
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.head: 超级管道附件
zh.create_hypertube.ponder.attachments.text: 扫描器附件可以让你检测在管道中穿梭的实体状态。（幼年生物-能量等级8；成年生物-能量等级15）
你也可以在超级管道加速器上添加附件，可同时在其不同的侧面放置多个附件。
红石检测附件可以让你使用红石信号切换超级管道加速器与超级管道入口的模式。

lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.card_cra: Location Cards are created from Iron Ingots and any Dye. The recipe produces 4 Location Cards. Alternatively one may substitute the iron for an ingot of %s and receive 16 cards from the same recipe.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.card_ove: Location Cards record spatial coordinates for use in multiversal devices.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.card_usa: To write location data to a card, a %s or %s is required at the correct coordinates or a standard issue %s with the coordinates already saved inside. Right-clicking the card onto a %s or %s will link the card to the device. Right-clicking the card onto the information panel for a location saved inside the %s will write the location data to the card.

Written cards can be used to supply location data to a %s or a %s. Cards obtained from other players only function with the %s if placed into a carried %s, however all cards can be freely used with the %s.
Placing a written Location Card into the crafting grid will wipe the data stored on the card allowing it to be reused.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.cell_cra: Chronon Cells can be created with materials on hand, such as Iron Ingots, Copper Ingots, Redstone Dust, and Amethyst Shards.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.cell_ove: Chronons are essential fuel for TVA multiversal technology, thus the first step to recreating this technology is generating and storing Chronons. Primitive Chronon Cells can store Chronons and be used as materials for more advanced technology.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.cell_usa: Empty Chronon Cells can be charged slowly over time if carried alongside a %s or a %s, or they can be placed inside a %s. Charged Chronon Cells will transfer their stored Chronons to all carried devices automatically, so long as they are all present in the main inventory or curio slots. Chronon Cells hold {X} Chronons.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.chronoma: Chronomarks are crafted from a Block of Iron, Iron Ingots, ingots of %s, an Ender Pearl, and a block of Tinted Glass.

The Chronomark is a stationary block used to generate exact spatial coordinates and provide them to other devices. As an upgrade over %s, Chronomarks allow for an offset of up to %s blocks to be specified in case the user wants to mount the device on a high ceiling or bury the device under the floor. They also allow for more user filtering options.

To write data to a %s, place the Chronomark and right-click it with a %s. The card will then be written and can be used with %s. The %s displays Chronomarks and %ss owned by the user automatically, but written %ss can be shared with others.

Filters can be set on the Chronomark to only allow certain users to freely access the device based on available and compatible team or guild frameworks. Right-clicking the device with an empty hand brings up an interface where device name, Timedoor color, security options, and offsets can be configured.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.chronome: Chronometers can be created from any basic Clock, along with a few extra components. Also required will be a block of Tinted Glass, ingots of %s, and a %s.

Chronometers are a Chronon generation device carried by the user to passively generate Chronons for their other devices. Properly crafted Chronometers generate Chronons at a faster rate than primitive solutions.

Kept in the main inventory or a curio slot, a Chronometer or %s will invert the temporal decay of local background radiation to synthesize Chronons, which are then distributed to all carried devices or storage cells automatically, so long as they are all present in the main inventory or curio slots.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.chronon_: Chronon Batteries can be created with %s, Iron Ingots, %ss, and Amethyst Shards, to power multiversal devices, and are the ideal way to carry Chronons on the go.
Chronon Batteries are devices for storing Chronons made from smaller cells. They hold more Chronons than individual %ss.

Empty Chronon Batteries can be charged slowly over time if carried alongside a %s or a %s, or they can be placed inside a %s. Charged Chronon Batteries will transfer their stored Chronons to all carried devices automatically, so long as they are all present in the main inventory or curio slots. Chronon Batteries hold %s Chronons.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.chronong: Chronon Generators can be created from any basic Clock, along with a block of Glass, Iron Ingots, and a %s
A Chronon Generator is a primitive device capable of generating Chronons for use with other devices.

Kept in the main inventory or a curio slot, a Chronon Generator or %s will invert the temporal decay of local background radiation to synthesize Chronons, which are then distributed to all carried devices or storage cells automatically, so long as they are all present in the main inventory or curio slots.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.location: Location Broadcasters are crafted with a block of Glass, an Emerald, a measure of Redstone Dust, a Compass, and an Iron Ingot.
The Location Broadcaster allow lost agents to be found and rescued by agents with specially upgraded %s.

The device can be used in the hand to toggle between its modes of operation. The screen on the device will glow green if teleportation is enabled, and will glow red if disabled. This allows the carrier to decide when they are open to Timedoors being opened to their location.
If a Location Broadcaster is carried in the inventory or curio slot and is turned on, the carrier will appearin the list of possible teleports for %s with the Teleport to Players upgrade.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.marker_c: They are crafted from a Block of Iron, Iron Ingots, an Ender Pearl, and a block of Glass.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.marker_o: The Timedoor Marker is used to generate exact spatial coordinates and provide them to other devices.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.marker_u: To write data to a %s, place the Timedoor Marker and right-click it with a %s. The card will then be written and can be used with the %s. The %s displays Timedoor Markers and %ss owned by the user automatically, but %ss linked to devices can be shared with others.
Right-clicking the device with an empty hand brings up an interface where device name, Timedoor color, and security options can be configured.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.metronom: Once booted, the Metronome will begin to generate Chronons into its own internal battery, which holds %s Chronons. Right-clicking the device will bring up the interface, where devices can be placed to store Chronons via the left-hand slots or take Chronons via the right-hand slots. Additionally, the Metronome is coded to the user’s temporal aura, and may be locked to prevent unauthorized access via the lock button in the upper right. It is locked by default.
Metronomes are crafted with Ingots of %s, Chronon Batteries, and an Ender Chest.

If the user places additional Metronomes, after booting they will link with existing Metronomes owned by the user in a multiversal network, combining their maximum storage capacities. Linked Metronomes will also combine charging power to generate more Chronons with each pulse.
Metronomes are a Chronon generation device that can be placed in the world to provide a stationary solution to charging devices and storing Chronons.

Generally, Metronomes cannot be charged within the inventory, and instead need to be placed into the world. There is an initial charge of Chronons needed to boot the device and gain access to its functionality after it is placed. This boot charge can be provided from a %s or %s in hand by crouch-right-clicking the Metronome.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.projecto: Timedoor Projectors are crafted from Copper Ingots, a Glass block, an Ender Pearl, a %s and Blocks of Iron.

When a standard issue %s is unavailable, rudimentary versions of the device can be crafted using materials on hand. The Timedoor Projector is the most basic device capable of allowing teleportation via Timedoors.
Timedoors are doorways between two points in space and/or time. They appear as glowing panels of glass, and can be passed through in either direction like any other doorway.
Timedoors consume Chronons from the Timedoor Projector upon generation and appear for a set amount of time before closing automatically.

Timedoor Projectors allow for the creation of Timedoors to spatial coordinates read from %ss. These can be loaded into the device by right-clicking the card onto the Timedoor Projector while it is either in the inventory or placed in the world, or by right-clicking a card in the inventory while holding the projector with the cursor. Cards can be retrieved from the device by either right-clicking it on an empty inventory space, or by right-clicking the device where it is placed in the world.

The device can be activated while held by using it (right-click). Holding crouch and using the device will place it on the block being looked at. Placing the Timedoor Projector allows it to be triggered by a Redstone signal instead, such as from an adjacent button.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.screenin: Screening Devices are crafted with a block of Tinted Glass, an Emerald, a measure of Redstone Dust, a Compass, and an ingot of %s.
The Screening Device is an advanced version of the %s that features more advanced filtering capability.

On a surface level, the Screening Device provides the same functionality as the %s, allowing users with upgraded %s to open Timedoors directly to their location. Additionally, the Screening Device can also filter who is given this permission based on available and compatible team or guild frameworks. Holding the device and right-click using it will cycle the device through its available modes.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.tempad_a: The New Location app allows the user to save their current coordinates in the Tempad to allow for travel via the Teleport app. A map is present on the screen to help users find their bearings when saving locations. The location can be named before saving, and the user may also specify a specific color for Timedoors opened to the location.

When docked on a %s, the terminal provides access to the Portal Setup app, allowing for selection of a destination from the user’s docked Tempad, and for precision tweaks to the opened Timedoor’s position and rotation (plus or minus %s blocks from the default position). This app is not available without docking the Tempad. Please see the %s entry for more information.

The Settings app allows users to adjust the behaviour of certain Tempad functions. The function of the Tempad’s macro button can be changed, as well as which app opens by default when the Tempad is opened.

Opening the Teleport app will present the user with a list of locations saved in the device, as well as the %ss or %ss owned by the user. Clicking these entries will populate the info panel to the right of the list, and enable the teleport button. Clicking the Teleport button will consume Chronons and generate a Timedoor to the location specified in the entry.

Next to the search bar, there is a button that will cycle through the available sorting modes. Locations may be sorted by dimension, alphabetical order, or by type. In all modes, locations are sorted into collapsible categories to make the list easier to view.

When a location is selected from the list, and the info panel to the right is populated, two additional buttons display at the bottom of the panel. The pin button will pin the location to the top of the list. Only one location may be pinned at a time. The X button will delete the location from the list. A %s right-clicked onto this information panel will be written with the location data from the saved location.

With a %s docked inside the Tempad, access is gained to the Travel Timeline app. This expands the functionality of the docked %s and gives more granular control, allowing the user to move back along to more points along their timeline instead of being limited to major events.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.tempad_c: The Tempad is crafted with blocks of Tinted Glass, a piece of Nether Quartz, an Ender Pearl, a Redstone Lamp, ingots of %s, and a %s.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.tempad_o: The standard issue Tempad is the single most powerful piece of technology covered in this database. A Tempad can create Timedoors to any coordinates saved in the device, as well as access a docked %s to allow the user to view and move along their personal timeline.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.tempad_t: Timedoors are doorways between two points in space and/or time. They appear as glowing panels of glass, and can be passed through in either direction like any other doorway.

Timedoors consume Chronons from the Tempad upon generation and appear for a set amount of time before closing automatically. %ss given a constant redstone signal will open a door indefinitely for a continuous Chronon cost.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.tempad_u: Holding the Tempad and right-clicking will bring up the Tempad’s interface as well as the user’s inventory. Tempad functionality is organized into apps and presented to the user through the app tray on the left of the interface. Clicking these app buttons will open the appropriate app within the device and give access to all of its powerful functions.
Location data can be added to the Tempad for teleporting via the New Location app. To use %ss with the Tempad, please see the %s.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.time_ste: Time Steel can be acquired in MC-21 and adjacent realms by crafting Netherite Scraps with Iron Ingots. Raw Iron to refine can be found in ore almost anywhere. Acquiring the scraps of Netherite, on the other hand, is contingent on access to a Nether dimension. It is inadvisable to get stuck on a timeline without access to these resources, as developing multiversal technology without it can lead to unstable results.

Time Steel is a crucial component to all advanced multiversal technology, as it is not affected by the passage of time. Thus it is a reliable material to house and shield all of the sensitive components required for traversing space and time.
Depending on the technology available in a given timeline, alternate or more efficient methods to produce Time Steel may be discovered. Recipe repositories may be checked for more details.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.time_twi: It is crafted with ingots of %s, blocks of Tinted Glass, a %s, and an Ender Pearl.
The Time Twister is a hand-held device that allows users to move back along significant events on their personal timeline.

Using the Time Twister in the hand will present the user with a radial display showing points in the user’s past where they changed dimensions or died. Clicking one of the options will teleport the user back to the indicated location. Any points on the timeline forward from the selected point (options counter-clockwise from the selected point) will be destroyed to prevent paradoxes.

Note that if the selected point involves moving the user to a different dimension, new options will appear in the Time Twister for leaving your current dimension and appearing in the new one. This means that in some instances the Time Twister can appear to not be deleting future entries properly, when in fact this is a failure of the user to pay attention.

If more granularity in timeline events is required, the Time Twister can be docked with a %s to provide access to the Travel Timeline app. The Time Twister is docked by right-clicking it onto a %s in the inventory, or by right-clicking a %s onto the Time Twister. This also provides the benefit of carrying the Time Twister without it taking an extra inventory slot.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.travel_a:
For agents dispatched to MC-21 or adjacent realms:

While the technology developed by the TVA is the most advanced in the multiverse, it is not capable of the impossible. Just as time doors cannot be opened to different points of time within the TVA, they cannot be opened to different points of time in MC-21 adjacent realms. Much like the TVA, time passes differently in MC-21 and all related branches, and as such, the TVA's technology is not capable of connecting different points in time within these locations. Spatial travel remains unaffected.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.wallet_c: Card Wallets can be crafted with Copper Ingots, Leather, and a blank %s.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.wallet_o: Card Wallets are a convenient way of storing and carrying a large amount of Location Cards.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.wallet_u: Right click the wallet in hand to open its storage. %ss may be placed in the storage for safe-keeping to keep the inventory from becoming too cluttered.

Once the user obtains a standard %s, Cards inside the wallet are automatically added to the %s’s location list if they are placed inside a carried wallet. Note that this is unnecessary for a %s or a %s owned by the user, as these devices are already added to the user’s %s. What this does enable, however, is the continued sharing of location cards between users, and being able to access these shared cards via the %s’s interface.

Only one Card Wallet can provide locations to the user’s %s at a given time. Priority is placed on the curio slot if available, then hotbar slots from left to right, then inventory slots from left to right, top to bottom.
lang.item.tempad.knowledge_projector.workstat: It can be crafted with blocks of Tinted Glass, Copper Ingots, ingots of %s, and a piece of Nether Quartz.
The Workstation is a stationary computer terminal that allows the user to accomplish various tasks when a %s is placed on the docking pad.

Docking a %s by right-clicking it onto the docking pad unlocks the cassette slot at the back to allow the use of Upgrade Tapes. Right-clicking an Upgrade Tape into the cassette slot applies the upgrade on the tape to the docked %s, provided the specific upgrade isn’t already present on the device.

When a %s is docked on the docking pad, the terminal to the left is also unlocked, allowing the user to set up a stationary teleportation device. The usage of the Workstation in this way is similar to the %s, in that it accepts a redstone signal from any side and creates a Timedoor for the user.

Right-clicking on the terminal, however, opens a new Portal Setup app, allowing for selection of a destination from the user’s docked %s, and for precision tweaks to the opened Timedoor’s position and rotation (plus or minus %s blocks in any direction from the default position). Additionally, if a constant redstone signal is applied the Timedoors will remain open until the signal stops, after which it will resume its normal countdown to close.

lang.gui.everycomp.error_screen.message:
The Every Compat Modules from the following supported mods had errors while loading. This usually means that the respective mods might have recently updated with breaking changes, requiring a future Every Compat update, or that one of the two mods' module is outdated.

If you don't want this to happen again please ask the author of said mod to CONSIDER including an Every Compat Module in their Mod instead.
The game can't proceed, but you can try to downgrade these supported mods to previous version & wait for an update: %s

lang.supplementaries.configuration.bellows.ba:
bellows pushes air following this equation: 
air=(sin(2PI*ticks/period)<0), with period = base_period-(redstone_power-1)*power_scaling 
represents base period at 1 power

lang.supplementaries.configuration.bellows.ba:
velocity increase uses this equation: 
vel = base_vel*((range-entity_distance)/range) with base_vel = base_velocity_scaling/period 
note that the block will push further the faster it's pulsing

lang.supplementaries.configuration.pulley_blo: Pulleys are automatically disabled if 'rope' feature is disabled

If true, pulleys retract their rope chain over multiple ticks, animating each block via vanilla moving-piston entities. 
Connected blocks become moving blocks (so they push entities, drop sand etc) and multiple pulleys can cooperate to pull a single heavy contraption, useful for elevators. 
If false, the original instant retraction behavior is used.

If true, multiple pulleys firing on the same tick with the same period and push direction can pool their pull budget into one structure resolve, letting two ropes share a wide elevator platform. Only relevant when 'continuous_retraction' is enabled.

Maximum number of NON-rope blocks a single pulley can drag (the anchor and anything sticky-attached to it). Rope segments don't count toward this. Cooperating pulleys pool their budgets: two pulleys can pull twice this many blocks together.

Ticks to wait between unit pulls when continuous_retraction is enabled. 
Lower = faster pulley. Minimum 2 ticks because each animation takes that long to play out, going lower has no effect.
Chance for a new mineshaft elevator piece to spawn

lang.supplementaries.configuration.piston_twe:
If true, pistons can push blocks that have a block entity (e.g. chests, furnaces). Blocks whose push reaction is BLOCK are still immovable regardless of this setting.
Quark takes priority here: while its 'pistons move tile entities' module is enabled this option does nothing and Quark handles piston moves instead, since the two implementations would otherwise both rebuild the moved block entity and wipe its contents. Turn that module off to use this one, which supports more cases (pulleys, cauldron filling, cooperative pistons).
Pulleys and ropes follow whichever implementation is active, so turning both off stops them from moving block entities too.

If true, adjacent pistons facing the same direction can pool their 12-block push budget to move structures larger than a single piston could handle alone (e.g. two side-by-side pistons pushing a 24-block slime contraption). Only triggers when a single piston's vanilla resolve would fail.
If true, pushing an empty cauldron into a water or lava source (with a piston or a pulley) fills it with that fluid, instead of leaving it empty. Also tops up cauldrons being moved.

Wind vane animation swings according to this equation: 
pitch(time) = max_angle_1*sin(2pi*time*pow/period_1) + <max_angle_2>*sin(2pi*time*pow/<period_2>)

zh.supplementaries.configuration.pulley_blo: “绳索”特性被禁用时会自动禁用滑轮

若为true，滑轮会在多个刻间拉动绳索，按原版移动活塞实体设置各方块的动画。
相连的方块会成为移动的方块（也即它们会推动实体，能让沙子下落等）；多个滑轮能协同运作，拉起同一个较重的结构，适合用来搭建电梯。
若为false，则使用原先的瞬时收缩行为。
若为true，周期相同、施力方向相同、且在同一刻启动的多个滑轮可将拉力协同解算于一个结构，两股绳索可由此共享同一个面积较大的电梯平台。仅在“持续拉绳”启用时生效。
单个滑轮可拉动的非绳索方块最大数量（即统计支点和所有与之黏性相连的方块）。绳索不计入此值。协作的滑轮会合并拉力：两个滑轮能拉动的方块是单个滑轮的两倍。

启用“滑轮协作”时，进行两次拉动之间的间隔。
值较小 = 滑轮较快。最短为2刻，因为动画的持续时间即为2刻，继续缩短也不会有效果。
生成废弃矿井电梯子结构的概率

若为true，活塞能推动具有方块实体的方块（如箱子、熔炉等）。推动反应为禁止的方块不受本设置影响。
Quark的设置会优先于本设置生效：Quark的“活塞移动方块实体”模块启用时，此设置不生效，完全交由Quark处理活塞的移动，否则两种实现会导致方块实体移动后内容物清空。关闭该模块可让此设置生效——本设置支持面更广（滑轮、炼药锅装填、活塞协作）。

若为true，朝向相同的相邻活塞会将两者的12方块推力合并，以此超出单一活塞的限制，推动更大的结构（如两个肩并肩的活塞可推动24方块的黏性结构）。只会在单一活塞在原版情况下判断失败时触发。
若为true，向水源或熔岩源推动空炼药锅（如使用活塞或滑轮）时，可令炼药锅装满相应流体，而非仍留空。也能填满炼药锅里空出的空间。

风向标的旋转动画遵循此公式：
音高(时间) = 最大角度1*sin(2pi*时间*信号强度/周期1) + 最大角度2*sin(2pi*时间*信号强度/周期2)
其中：
 - 信号强度 = max(1,红石信号强度*信号强度缩放)
 - 时间 = 以刻计的时间
 - 红石信号强度 = 方块的红石信号强度
强度缩放 = 强度中变化的频繁程度。2代表它每追加一级级信号强度，其旋转速度都会翻倍（降雨为2，雷暴为4）
增大此值，即可在天气变化时起到更明显的指示作用

If enabled, then command feedback is automatically disabled
and then re-enabled for multiplayer Paste, Fill and Delete operations
(which are using /setblock and /fill commands) by disabling and then
re-enabling the sendCommandFeedback game rule when the task is finished

The maximum size/volume of each individual box
that can be filled via the command-based Fill/Delete
operations. Bigger areas/volumes will get split to multiple commands.
All areas are also split to per-chunk boxes at first anyway.

Disables dividing the fill volumes (in the Fill, Replace and Delete modes)
to per-chunk boxes

Maximum number of commands sent per game tick,
when using the Paste, Fill and Delete features on a server,
where they will use setblock and fill commands.
Note that he Paste feature can overshoot this by a couple of commands
when using the NBT restore functionality, which needs two additional commands for each block.

The clone command name to use when using the
command-based creative mode functionality on servers.
This is currently only used by the Paste function if the NBT restore
behavior is set to 'Place & Clone'.

The fill command name to use when using the
command-based creative mode functionality on servers

The setblock command name to use when using the
command-based creative mode functionality on servers,
namely the Paste Schematic in World function

The summon command name to use when using the
command-based creative mode functionality on servers,
namely the Paste Schematic in World function

The interval in game ticks the Paste, Fill and Delete tasks
are executed at. The commandLimitPerTick config sets the maximum
number of commands to send per execution, and this config
sets the interval in game ticks before the next execution.

Enables the use of the §dstrict§r parameter in all
§bfill§r, §bsetblock§r, and §bclone§r commands.
Using this new vanilla parameter,
this helps to stop block updates.

If enabled, instead of using the configured setblock and fill commands,
the World Edit //pos1, //pos2 and //set commands are used.

than using vanilla commands due to the command limit per tick,
and WE requiring multiple commands per block or area (//pos1 //pos2 //set).

is that they can prevent block updates, if the server doesn't have
the Carpet mod and thus the '/carpet fillUpdates false' rule available.

- Auto: Uses v3 in single player, and by default Slabs-only in multiplayer,

- Version 3: Only supported by Litematica itself (in single player) or with Servux.
- Version 2: Compatible with servers with the Carpet mod
  (either QuickCarpet by skyrising and DeadlyMC,
  or CarpetExtra in addition to FabricCarpet.
  And in both cases the 'accurateBlockPlacement' Carpet rule needs
  to be enabled on the server).
- Slabs only: Only fixes top slabs. Compatible with Paper servers.
- None: Does not modify coordinates.

blocks with a block entity with the NBT restore option enabled.

would otherwise fail for many blocks with a low command rate.

lang.litematica.config.generic.comment.pasteN:
Whether or not the NBT data of blocks is attempted to be restored,
and which method is used for that.
- Place & Data Modify will try to place the "NBT-picked" block
  near the player, and then use the data modify
  command to transfer the NBT data to the setblock'ed block
- Place & Clone will try to place the "NBT-picked" block
  near the player, and then clone it to the final location.
- Teleport & Place will try to teleport the player nearby and then
  directly place the NBT-picked item in the correct position.
Note that the teleport & place method doesn't currently work correctly/at all.
The recommended method is §ePlace & Data Modify§r, however for that to work
you will probably need to lower the pasteCommandLimit to 1 per tick and increase
the pasteCommandInterval to 1-4 ticks or something.
Thus you should only use this for pasting important blocks that need the data,
for example by making a schematic of just the inventories,
and then paste that with replace behavior set to None.

the command-based Paste operation (which is used on servers)
will also try to use /fill commands for any continuous areas of the same block.
This has no effect in single player, since the mod sets the blocks directly
in the integrated server's world in and doesn't use commands at all.

This is a temporary hack workaround to use the command-based pasting
also in single player, which allows using the render layer limited
pasting in single player, which currently doesn't work with
the direct world access pasting that single player normally uses.

Note that this will have all the same NBT data restoration
limitations that multiplayer pasting has normally.

Use Servux to paste a schematic directly to the server.

command-based method, and it supports restoring

lang.litematica.config.generic.comment.placem:
Adjust the Placement Manager Thread performance metrics as follows:

MAX - 32 tasks per cycle (20ms yield, 2048 deferred cap)
DEFAULT - 16 tasks per cycle (50ms yield, 1024 deferred cap)
MINIMAL - 8 tasks per cycle (100ms yield, 512 deferred cap)
POTATO - 4 task per cycle (150ms yield, 128 deferred cap)

Lower profiles reduce CPU load and prevent frame drops on weaker
systems, but chunk rebuilds will take noticeably longer to complete.

Set the max number of Placement Manager Threads
NOTE: The default value (§e0§r) safely scales to your
system's CPU core count, and the actual thread usage
can be seen by enabling the §bdebugHudPMThreads§r
config for your F3 screen.
§6NOTE: Just because you can technically allocate
§616 threads, doesn't mean you should.
§eGenerally, 2 or 4 should be enough for most users.

lang.litematica.config.generic.comment.unhide:
Un-hides the Schematic VCS (Version Control System) menu button,

zh.litematica.config.generic.comment.placem:
请按如下方式调整“放置管理器线程”（Placement Manager Thread）的性能参数：

最大(MAX)—— 每周期 32 个任务（让步间隔 20ms，延迟任务上限 2048）
默认(DEFAULT)—— 每周期 16 个任务（让步间隔 50ms，延迟任务上限 1024）
极低(MINIMAL)—— 每周期 8 个任务（让步间隔 100ms，延迟任务上限 512）
极简(POTATO)—— 每周期 4 个任务（让步间隔 150ms，延迟任务上限 128）

较低的配置模式有助于降低 CPU 负载，
从而防止在性能较弱的系统上出现帧率骤降（掉帧）的问题；
但作为代价，区块重构（Chunk Rebuilds）所需的时间将会显著增加。

设置“放置管理器线程”（Placement ManagerThreads）的最大数量。
注意：默认值（§e0§r）能够安全地根据您系统的 CPU 核心数进行自动适配；
若想查看实际的线程使用情况，您可以在 F3 调试界面中启用 §b调试 - HUD放置管理器线程数(debugHudPMThreads)§r 配置项。
§6注意：即便从技术上讲您可以分配 16 个线程，但这并不意味着您真的应该这样做。
§e通常而言，对于绝大多数用户来说，分配 2 或 4 个线程就已经足够了。

lang.lighty.options.sky_threshold.tooltip: If the block light level is below the value specified in 'Block Threshold' and the sky light level is less than or equal to %d, the overlay is red. Otherwise, it is orange.
lang.lighty.options.overlay_distance.tooltip: The radius of the area covered by the light overlay, in chunks. Defaults to 2. High overlay distance may impact performance severally.
lang.lighty.options.overlay_brightness.toolti: The brightness of the rendered overlay. Defaults to 10. Especially useful when using shaders.
lang.lighty.options.show_safe.tooltip: If on, the overlay gets rendered on safe (green) spots.
lang.lighty.options.show_skylight_level.toolt: If on, Number Mode shows both block-light and sky-light levels. (Default: ON)
lang.lighty.options.auto_on.tooltip: If on, the overlay gets enabled when holding an item of certain type. (Default: OFF, Default items: minecraft:torch, minecraft:soul_torch, minecraft:lantern, minecraft:soul_lantern)

zh.modeSwitcher.lighty.number_mode.tooltip: 上方数字为方块光，下方数字为天空光。
zh.modeSwitcher.lighty.carpet_mode.tooltip: Lighty独有的类似地毯的显示效果。

zh.settings.lighty.title: Lighty 设置
zh.lighty.selected.tooltip:
当前选择的覆盖层显示模式。
点击以更改。
zh.lighty.overlay.tooltip:
当前覆盖层是否显示。
点击即可开关。
开关快捷键: %s。
zh.lighty.overlay.title: 选择一种覆盖层
zh.lighty.options.block_threshold.tooltip:
当方块光小于等于%d时，覆盖层会变成红色或橙色 (取决于天空光亮度)。
如果够亮则为绿色。
zh.lighty.options.farm_growth_threshold.too:
当亮度大于%d时，覆盖层为绿色 (说明作物能够生长)。
低于该值时覆盖层为橙色 (作物无法生长)。
默认值为8。
zh.lighty.options.farm_uproot_threshold.too:
当亮度小于%d时，覆盖层为红色 (作物无法种植)。
默认值为8。
zh.lighty.options.sky_threshold.tooltip:
当方块光小于它的阈值 并且
天空光小于等于%d时，覆盖层为红色。
否则覆盖层为橙色。
zh.lighty.options.overlay_distance.tooltip:
渲染半径多少区块内的覆盖层，默认值为2
过度调高数值可能会严重影响性能！
zh.lighty.options.overlay_brightness.toolti:
调整覆盖层的亮度，默认值为10。
在使用光影时会非常有用。
zh.lighty.options.show_safe.tooltip: 覆盖层会显示在安全点 (绿色) 上。
zh.lighty.options.auto_on.tooltip:
手上拿着特殊物品时自动显示覆盖层。
默认为关，默认物品为
minecraft:torch (火把)
